descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Product Manager – Supply Chain Management, you will own and evolve the technology platforms and workflows that power Licious’ end-to-end supply chain. You will work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Data, Engineering, and Finance teams to build products that improve freshness, reduce waste, and enable scalable growth.

This role requires strong product judgment, comfort with operational complexity, and the ability to balance speed, reliability, and long-term platform thinking.



What makes the role meaty...


Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for supply chain systems across demand planning, procurement, production planning, warehousing, inventory, and logistics
  • Translate business goals (freshness, fill rate, cost, SLA adherence) into clear product outcomes and success metrics
  • Identify automation and digitization opportunities across supply chain workflows

Execution & Delivery

  • Lead discovery, prioritization, and delivery of features across internal platforms
  • Write high-quality PRDs, define user journeys, and ensure on-time execution with engineering and design teams
  • Drive experimentation and continuous improvement using data and operational feedback

Demand, Inventory & Planning

  • Build products that improve forecast accuracy, replenishment, and inventory turns
  • Partner with Data Science teams on forecasting models and decision-support tools
  • Enable real-time visibility into inventory, wastage, and capacity across nodes

Operations & Reliability

  • Design systems that ensure traceability, compliance, and quality control
  • Improve exception management, alerts, and operational dashboards
  • Balance system reliability with rapid iteration in a 24x7 operational environment

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the product SPOC for Supply Chain and Operations leadership
  • Collaborate with Finance, Category, and Retail teams on cost, margins, and availability
  • Influence roadmap trade-offs by balancing operational needs and tech scalability


We hope that you have..


Experience

  • 6–10 years of product management experience, preferably in Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, Retail Ops, or Food/FMCG
  • Hands-on experience building internal platforms or operational products
  • Proven track record of shipping complex products in high-scale environments

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with metrics, dashboards, and models
  • Ability to work with ambiguity and evolving operational constraints
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and influence skills

Good to Have

  • Experience in fresh food, cold chain, or perishable supply chains
  • Exposure to demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or WMS/TMS systems
  • Experience working with data science and optimization problems

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

 

Job summary

We are seeking Principal Platform Product Manager to define and lead DigiCert's API platform as both an internal engineering standard and externally differentiated developer product. This is a dual access role: inbound, you are the Platform authority who sets API structure, governance, guardrails and developer experience standards that all DigiCert product teams build to. Outbound, you are the thought leader who shapes the developer portal, external API experience and MCP strategy that customers, partners and 3rd party developers depend on. The person in this role will simultaneously be the most demanding internal API standard setter and the most credible external advocate for what a best-in-class digital trust API platform can be.

The Principal Platform Product Manager is responsible to understand market needs and trends, collaborate with product teams horizontally across the portfolio, manage the delivery and success of initiatives and supporting platform components in a data-driven manner, and drive priorities that maximize platform value to both internal and external customers. The Principal Platform Product Manager will lead strategic and tactical activities for large, broad, and highly complex initiatives that impact all portfolio solutions, not limited to Platform. This is a critical, highly visible role charged with the strategy and driving the execution of priority initiatives at all levels across the organization. Individuals in this role will also mentor lower-level contributors. This role has a seat on the Platform Product Management team. 

 

What you will do

The Principal API Platform Product Manager serves as the primary owner of our API Platform initiative, with substantial contribution and stakes in several other Platform initiatives. In support of this mission, this role will conduct internal and external research: customer requirements, market requirements, competitive research, internal research and analysis to inform strategic direction and priorities. They will establish a backlog of portfolio requirements that express dependencies on the Platform and actively maintain a prioritized stack-ranking to inform their executable roadmap and regularly collaborate across the business to collect and socialize a comprehensive, accurate and detailed set of feature requirements for one or more major platform initiatives. As the thought leader for API Platform, this role is responsible for constructing both the internal and external visions and leading discussions with functional leadership across the organization to gain alignment.   Primary responsibilities and Duties include:   Outbound Elements:
  • Own the collective API vision for Platform, including strategy, planning, and execution - and share accountability for the outcome
  • Serve as externally facing subject matter expert with customer, partner and developer audiences to gain deep understanding of their needs, represent strategy and roadmap, solicit participation in proof of concepts, beta releases, advisory counsels
  • Serve as thought leader for API requirements at DigiCert: meet with analysts to discuss market dynamics and competitive positioning, publish articles/white papers, post relevant content to engage with their external stakeholder community
  • Work closely with Finance to develop Pricing and Packaging strategies
  • Work closely with Marketing to develop GTM strategy, messaging, positioning and supporting artifacts

Inbound Elements: 

  • Own and understand API-specific platform requirements such as developer experience, webhook frameworks, API governance, security/compliance controls, automated documentation, version/change management; serve as subject matter expert for API requirements across functions to drive collaboration and achieve alignment on objectives, requirements, dependencies, design, and implementation
  • Leads the decomposition of strategic objectives into phased operational and tactical goals and measures that translates into platform implications (e.g. APIs, metering, lifecycle management, reporting, portal), and work with the teams in each of these areas establish requirements, align on priorities, and choreograph delivery
  • Lead the discussion to set business priorities that feed into the planning and execution of API Platform in close collaboration with other product teams and functions to ensure alignment with the needs of the business.
  • Responsible and accountable for the technical vision, strategy, planning and execution - and shares accountability for the outcome
  • Work across all platform teams (e.g. Access Control, API, Common Services, Customer Experience) on roadmap planning cycles, backlog discovery and prioritization, pre-development design and alignment, and operational execution
  • Be responsible and accountable for API Platform acceptance and success criteria of every internal and external release
  • Leads the buy/build assessment for platform components where appropriate, along with vendor assessment and proposal
  • Owns the technical definition, prioritization and hygiene of product backlog(s) throughout the concept through delivery process
  • Owns the execution and outcome by partnering closely with immediate platform core team (Engineering, Architecture & UX) as well solutions core teams to represent business objectives along with support

Skills/Competencies:

  • Proven aptitude for cross-functional diplomacy leading complex initiatives with portfolio-wide implications and impact across all organizational functions
  • Demonstrated ability to lead the solutioning to deconstruct technical challenges to meet stakeholder requirements and platform objectives
  • Mastery of balanced decision making and decision follow-through – including problem definition, alternative definition and selection, trade-off analysis, success criteria definition, and overall execution
  • Able to earn credibility as the internally recognized specialist on complex platform technical and business matters. Uses judgment within broadly defined policies and practices and solves most problems without assistance 
  • Experience and demonstrated dedication managing and meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; seeking first-hand customer information and using it to inform feature definition and development; bringing a cohesive perspective of the customers to their work
  • Proficient decision making and decision follow-through - including defining a problem, identifying different alternatives, selecting and implementing the best alternative, and evaluating results to success criteria
  • Highly detail-oriented and able to manage many tasks for multiple requesters simultaneously
  • Ability to foster credibility amongst peers, to find common ground and solve problems for the good of all, represent their own interests yet be fair to other groups, can solve problems with with a minimum of disruption/escalation

 

What you will have

  • 10 + years of experience in a technical or product role
  • Proven experience and depth of understanding of Enterprise API Governance and best practices
  • Experience with / working understanding of commercial API Platforms and the problems they solve for customers, partners and developers
  • A working understanding of Model Context Protocol, and how it is used in association with APIs by internal and external stakeholders
  • Credential or degree in business or engineering/computer science 

 

Nice to have

  • Platform Product Management Experience
  • MBA or Advanced Technical degree/credentials 

 

Benefits

  • Generous time off policies
  • Top shelf benefits
  • Education, wellness and lifestyle support

descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager I - Agent Platform & Governance

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager I to help define how AI agents, MCP clients, and enterprise workflows safely interact with the Sumo Logic platform.

As AI becomes a broader interface for accessing data, insights, and platform capabilities, customers need confidence that every agentic workflow is secure, governed, auditable, and aligned with enterprise controls. This role will own key product areas across MCP strategy, agent governance, headless invocation, agent-to-agent integrations, RBAC, rate limiting, throttling, quotas, admin controls, and auditability.

You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, AI, platform, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous platform and governance needs into scalable product capabilities. This is a hands-on role for someone who can operate at the intersection of technical platform depth, enterprise customer trust, and fast-moving AI product strategy.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own product strategy and execution for MCP and governed agent access to Sumo Logic capabilities.
  • Define how agents, tools, skills, APIs, and external clients can safely interact with the Sumo Logic platform.
  • Drive requirements for headless agent invocation, including access patterns across external clients, partner tools, IDEs, terminals, Slack, and other future surfaces.
  • Shape Sumo Logic’s approach to agent-to-agent integrations, including invocation boundaries, trust models, permissioning, and auditability.
  • Define governance models for tools, skills, agents, context, memory, and reusable content across the AI platform.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture on rate limiting, throttling, quotas, tenant isolation, abuse prevention, and safe defaults for agentic workflows.
  • Drive product requirements for RBAC, data access controls, service accounts, OAuth/API access, service allowlisting, and admin-configured policies as they apply to agents and MCP-based access.
  • Define enterprise admin controls for managing agent access, approved tools, accessible content, long-term memory, context sources, and policy enforcement.
  • Ensure agentic actions are observable, auditable, permission-aware, and explainable to enterprise admins.
  • Translate strategic direction into crisp PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
  • Use telemetry to monitor agent usage, MCP adoption, tool calls, rate-limit hits, permission failures, policy violations, latency, and operational reliability.
  • Create leadership-facing proposals that clearly explain tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, platform complexity, and long-term architecture.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, security, IAM, APIs, AI platforms, developer platforms, observability, or security products.
  • Strong technical product instincts around permissions, governance, APIs, platform architecture, admin controls, and enterprise-scale systems.
  • Familiarity with AI agent concepts such as MCP, tools, skills, agent orchestration, headless invocation, agent-to-agent workflows, context, memory, and guardrails.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise controls such as RBAC, OAuth, API keys, service accounts, audit logs, policy enforcement, rate limits, throttling, quotas, and data access boundaries.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, identify edge cases, and think through how product capabilities behave under real enterprise constraints.
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, failures, and risk.
  • Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences.
  • Ability to write clear product proposals, decision docs, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • A fast learner who can quickly ramp on emerging areas like MCP, agent governance, AI platform architecture, and enterprise AI controls.
  • High ownership, hustle, and drive to make progress in ambiguous, fast-moving product areas.

Must-Have Qualities

  • Asks the right questions - especially around trust, permissioning, edge cases, customer impact, and failure modes.
  • Strong communicator - can explain complex platform and governance concepts clearly.
  • High drive and ownership - pushes through ambiguity and drives execution.
  • Strong analytical capability — uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine product decisions.
  • Quick learner - can rapidly understand MCP, governance, IAM, AI agents, and platform architecture.
  • Tradeoff thinker - can frame options, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly.

Why Join Sumo Logic?

You will be working on one of the largest scale data problems in the industry. Your work directly impacts the company’s bottom line and determines our ability to innovate by freeing up capital for new product investments.

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

  • Gather requirements across clients and industry verticals to identify scope and maximize reusability of new feature requests.
  • Manage the product backlogincluding dependencies, priority, sequence, strategy, and business objectives.
  • Identify and address challenges that arise during the product development lifecycle, collaborating with team members to find creative solutions and keep development on track.
  • Provide mechanisms for teams and stakeholders to view and track team and product work progress across releases and major product milestones.
  • Share vision and purpose for all product development efforts, gaininginterest and buy-in from various audiences, including business and technical roles at multiple levels of the organization.
  • Be a steward for excellence in your domain of expertise, advocating for and evolving platform standards while building the team's shared understanding.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 7+ years working in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role
  • Demonstrated experience driving Agile/Scrum delivery projects that involve web-based software development and 3rd party integrations via API and batch
  • Strong technical background, with a knack for translating concepts into language business and tech roles can understand
  • Dot connector, ability to identify patterns and navigate complex challenges
  • Loyalty product, program, or industry experience a plus
  • Familiarity with UX research and best practices a plus
  • PMI-PBA/CBAP/CSPO/PSPO certification a plus 
  • Bachelor's degree

About Kobie

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.

As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.

We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.

Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.

As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.

Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager – Web & Apps

Location: Mumbai

Company: Pinkvilla Media Pvt. Ltd.


About Pinkvilla

Pinkvilla is one of India’s leading digital media platforms covering entertainment, lifestyle, and pop culture, reaching millions of users across web and mobile apps. We are building the next generation of content experiences driven by product, data, and innovation.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to work on the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Pinkvilla’s website and mobile applications (iOS & Android). This role requires a strong mix of consumer product thinking, data-driven decision-making, and execution excellence to enhance user engagement, retention, and monetization.


Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Leadership

  • Work with the product team in managing end-to-end product lifecycle for Pinkvilla’s web and app platforms
  • Define and drive the product roadmap aligned with business goals (traffic, engagement, revenue)
  • Identify new opportunities in content consumption, personalization, and user experience

User Experience & Growth

  • Improve user journeys across content discovery, reading, video consumption, and sharing
  • Drive SEO, app engagement, retention, and DAU/MAU growth
  • Optimize funnels (homepage → article → video → subscription/ad engagement)

Data & Analytics

  • Use tools like Google Analytics, Firebase, Mixpanel, etc. to track performance
  • Run A/B tests and experiments to improve conversion and engagement
  • Define and monitor key metrics: retention, session time, bounce rate, CTR

Monetization

  • Work closely with revenue teams to optimize ad placements, page performance, and yield
  • Explore new monetization streams (subscriptions, commerce integrations, branded content formats)

Execution & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, editorial, SEO, and sales teams
  • Translate business requirements into clear product requirements (PRDs)
  • Drive sprint planning, prioritization, and timely delivery

Platform & Performance

  • Improve site speed, app performance, and scalability
  • Ensure best practices in Core Web Vitals, app stability, and UX standards


Requirements

Experience

  • 5 - 8+ years in Product Management (preferably in media, content, or consumer internet)
  • Proven experience managing high-traffic websites and mobile apps

Skills

  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior, content platforms, and engagement loops
  • Hands-on with analytics tools (GA4, Firebase, Mixpanel, etc.)
  • Experience working with SEO, content products, or ad-driven businesses
  • Ability to balance editorial needs + product scalability
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Technical Understanding

  • Good understanding of frontend/backend systems, APIs, CMS platforms
  • Familiarity with app ecosystems (iOS/Android), push notifications, and personalization engines

descriptionHtml:
About the Role:


You will work at the intersection of academic complexity and intuitive product design, translating the needs of administrators, faculty, and students into features that genuinely transform how institutions operate. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, customer success, and sales to deliver a product that resonates with institutions across India and beyond.


Roles & Responsibilities

● Own and evolve the product roadmap for the Academics vertical — covering attendance, timetabling, curriculum, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules.

● Prioritise features and enhancements by synthesising customer feedback, usage analytics, and institutional trends in higher education.

● Balance short-term customer requests with long-term platform vision, ensuring decisions align with Digii’s growth objectives.

● Conduct regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty, and students across partner institutions to surface pain points and unmet needs.

● Analyse product usage data, support tickets, and market signals to identify gaps and new product opportunities within the academics vertical.

● Partner with customer success and sales teams to bring the voice of the customer into every sprint and planning cycle.

● Translate complex academic workflows into clear, actionable PRDs and user stories that engineering and design teams can execute on with confidence.

● Drive agile ceremonies — sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives — ensuring the team ships high-quality releases on time.

● Coordinate cross-functional launches with design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to ensure smooth feature rollouts.

● Monitor adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics post-launch and iterate rapidly based on data and user feedback.

● Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, ensuring the most impactful work is always prioritised.

● Act as the primary product contact for academics module stakeholders — internally (sales, CS, engineering) and externally (institutional admins and faculty).

● Communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release timelines clearly and regularly to leadership and cross-functional peers.


Requirements Must Haves

● 4–6 years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a strong track record of shipping B2B SaaS products end-to-end.

● Proven ability to own a product vertical independently — from discovery and roadmap definition to execution and post-launch iteration.

● Strong understanding of academic workflows in higher education — including timetabling, curriculum management, LMS, attendance, and student lifecycle processes.

● Data-driven decision-making: comfortable with product analytics tools and translating metrics into product improvements.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared product vision.

● Hands-on experience working in agile environments, running sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs.


Good to Have

● Prior experience working with Indian higher education institutions — universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges.

● Familiarity with LMS platforms (Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary platforms) and academic ERP systems.

● Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.

● Working knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, and Figma.

● Experience collaborating with customer-facing teams (sales, support, customer success) to gather and action institutional feedback.

● Passion for the education sector and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for students and institutions.


Digii’s commitment to you

● Opportunity to make a dent in higher education globally.Competitive Pay

● An open culture that thrives on passion and excellence.

● A true sense of satisfaction where your work would help millions of students have a better campus experience.

● Access to top entrepreneurs, technologists, and leaders for brainstorming and mentorship.

● This role is based in Bangalore (on-site). Management trusts you to make the best use of your time, with performance measured by impact, not hours.

● We believe this opportunity will be a success for everyone when we truly unlock your potential. This role has strong room for growth in the organisation.

descriptionHtml:
WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Why this role exists


CloudSEK helps enterprises predict and prioritize threats before breach, not just react after one. Our stack spans digital risk protection (XVigil), attack surface management (BeVigil), supply chain intelligence (SVigil), and threat intelligence, unified on Nexus AI: an AI command center that correlates signals, maps attack paths, and quantifies risk in terms security and business leaders understand.


We’re at an inflection point: strong products in each domain, growing international footprint, and a platform bet to connect the dots for customers. We need a Senior PM who thinks in cybersecurity outcomes - exposure, threat context, prioritization, remediation - and can turn that into products customers adopt and expand on.


What you’ll own


You’ll own significant product areas on the CloudSEK Platform, shaping how enterprise security teams discover risk, understand threat context, and act with confidence.

Your work will sit at the intersection of:


  • Threat intelligence & early warning reconnaissance-stage signals - CVE/IAV context, actor and campaign awareness
  • External risk visibility - digital risk, brand abuse, leaked credentials, and attack surface exposure
  • Prioritization & action - helping customers answer what matters most, why, and what to do next (not another feed of alerts)
  • Platform experience - workflows, integrations, and cross-product capabilities that make CloudSEK feel like one intelligence system, not four separate tools


You’ll partner closely with Threat Intel Research, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Customer Success . Our research capability is a core differentiator, and this role helps translate it into product buyers can operationalize.


What you’ll do


Product strategy

  • Research market trends, competitive moves, and customer workflows across DRP, ASM, TI, and platform consolidation
  • Define and communicate product vision and roadmap aligned with CloudSEK’s growth
  • Prioritize investments that drive adoption, retention, and expansion in existing accounts


Product development

  • Partner with engineering to turn customer and research insights into clear requirements, releases, and measurable outcomes
  • Work with design so complex security data is usable for analysts, threat hunters, and executive stakeholders
  • Balance speed and quality on a roadmap that spans point capabilities and platform-level experiences


Go-to-market

  • Shape positioning, messaging, and sales enablement for new capabilities
  • Help Marketing and Sales articulate CloudSEK’s differentiation vs. point solutions and legacy intel vendors


Customer engagement

  • Engage directly with enterprise customers to validate decisions, improve adoption, and uncover expansion opportunities
  • Close the loop on product friction with CS and account teams


Metrics

  • Define and track KPIs for platform health, feature adoption, and customer outcomes
  • Use quantitative and qualitative signals to refine priorities continuously


Who we’re looking for


Must-have

  • 7–10 years in product management, with substantial experience in B2B cybersecurity
  • Deep familiarity with how security teams work and how cyber products are evaluated, bought, and used in enterprise environments
  • Hands-on product experience in at least one of: threat intelligence, attack surface / exposure management, digital risk protection, vulnerability prioritization, security operations workflows, or security platform / data products
  • Supply chain, third-party, or vendor risk - meaningful experience here is important; you understand TPRM / software supply chain problems and how they connect to broader security posture
  • Strong analytical judgment and clear communication across technical researchers, engineers, and business buyers
  • Comfort in agile, high-velocity product environments


Strong plus

  • Experience building SaaS platform capabilities unified workflows, integrations, APIs, RBAC, or cross-product experiences that connect multiple security domains
  • Exposure to risk quantification, attack-path / graph thinking, or AI-assisted prioritization
  • Experience with global enterprise buyers and security procurement
  • Bachelor’s or MBA; technical degree is a plus but not required if domain depth is clear


Why join CloudSEK


  • Cybersecurity - AI native company - prediction and IAV-focused narrative, not a bolt-on security module on generic SaaS
  • Full-stack exposure story DRP, ASM, TI, and supply chain in one portfolio; platform correlation is the strategic bet
  • Research ↔ product - work adjacent to a serious threat research org, not distant from it
  • Global momentum - product choices here shape how we win and retain enterprise accounts internationally

descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE:

Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.


ABOUT THE ROLE: Principal Product Manager

As a Principal Product Manager at Aviatrix, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert and thought leader, owning the strategy and long-term vision for a set of interrelated features and solution areas within our multi-cloud networking platform. You will drive significant initiatives that shape product value and market differentiation, influencing the product roadmap at the leadership level.

Working closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and customers, you will identify emerging opportunities, make high-stakes prioritization decisions, and lead cross-functional collaboration that defines Aviatrix's competitive position across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and beyond.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and drive the long-term vision and comprehensive strategy for a set of interrelated features and solution areas, aligning them to the product's strategic goals, market position, and overall company vision.
  • Influence the product roadmap at the leadership level by identifying future opportunities based on emerging industry trends, evolving user needs, and the competitive landscape.
  • Engage regularly with enterprise customers, many of whom are based in the U.S., participating in product discussions, roadmap reviews, and strategic sessions; flexibility to schedule and attend meetings across time zones is expected.
  • Establish prioritization frameworks for interdependent features that are adopted across product teams, and communicate rationale clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • Make critical, high-stakes decisions on feature scope and strategic direction, balancing cross-functional input, market insights, and risk assessment to drive outcomes that impact the broader Product Management function.
  • Lead execution across multiple interrelated features, overseeing project roadmaps, assigning responsibilities across teams, and establishing standards for quality delivery.
  • Anticipate execution risks and adapt plans proactively based on resource or market changes, ensuring smooth cross-functional collaboration.
  • Maintain deep customer focus by synthesizing feedback and real-world enterprise challenges into strategic product decisions, ensuring Aviatrix solutions address critical pain points at scale.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep Aviatrix at the forefront of enterprise cloud networking and security.
  • Drive strategic-level communication across functions, providing detailed roadmap updates, vision presentations, and reports to leadership and executive teams.
  • Partner with ecosystem partners and internal teams to validate strategy and deliver measurable, impactful results.
  • Evangelize Aviatrix's solutions as an internal and external subject matter expert through thought leadership, technical white papers, webinars, and speaking engagements.
  • Mentor and develop junior product managers on execution, collaboration, and strategic thinking best practices.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in product management within the cloud or networking domain, with a demonstrated track record of driving product strategy at scale (or 8+ years with a Master's degree).
  • Broad expertise and deep specialization in cloud networking technologies, including VPN, SDN, SD-WAN, firewalls, routing protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, IPSec, and cloud-native networking across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Proven experience leading strategy and execution for a set of interrelated features or product areas, with direct influence on long-term product roadmap and business outcomes.
  • Experience with multi-cloud architectures, networking protocols, and infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Hands-on experience with at least two major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Networking, Azure Networking, Google Cloud Networking).
  • Recognized ability to lead cross-functional collaboration, build consensus, and influence stakeholders up to the executive level.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into strategic narratives for diverse audiences, including C-suite.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior product managers.
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to accommodate meetings with customers and stakeholders based in the U.S. and other global time zones.

descriptionHtml:
01

Why this exists

What if the app that handles your home's money actually understood how homes work?

The Indian consumer payments stack is functionally solved. UPI works. Wallets work. What's not solved is how money actually moves between the people who live together — flatmates settling rent and groceries, partners managing a shared household, families coordinating around staff and bills and birthday gifts. The everyday money inside an Indian home is still a WhatsApp message and a mental note.

Fave is the bet that this changes — and that the company that wins shared money becomes the operating layer for a generation of Indian consumers.

We've built the beta. Real users, real spend, real signal. Now we need someone to own the product as it scales.

02

The role

You'd own the product end-to-end. Strategy, roadmap, ship cadence, the whole thing.

There's no PM org to inherit — you'll build it. There's no playbook for what we're doing — you'll write it. You'll partner with strong, opinionated peers leading engineering and marketing/design who already know the product cold. The job is to bring product judgment to a team that has nearly everything else.

This is not a managerial role with an IC ladder underneath it. You'll lead, but you'll also build. You'll write specs you actually want to write. You'll prototype a feature before scoping it out. You'll ship a thing on a weekend because you couldn't stop thinking about it. The day you stop contributing individually is the day this role stops working.

What you'll spend time on:

→ Cross-functional leadership. Drive alignment with engineering, design, marketing, and BD — without managing them. The hardest part of this job is moving a team you don't own toward a north star they help define.

→ Knowing the customer better than anyone in the room. Live in the segment. Talk to users constantly. Understand the social, financial, and behavioural texture of how young Indians live and spend together. Customer obsession isn't a value here, it's a daily practice.

→ Combining insight and analytics to make agile decisions. You move between qualitative signal and quantitative truth fluently. You don't wait for the perfect dashboard, and you don't shoot from the hip. You triangulate.

→ Running the experimentation engine. Define hypotheses, design tests, decide what's instrumented, call results honestly. The team should ship 5–10 experiments a month, and you should be able to defend every one of them.

→ Owning activation and retention. The cohort retention number is the north star. You live with it, and you're accountable for it.

→ Defining what we build — and what we don't. The hardest call in a product like this isn't "what's possible." It's "what's next." That's yours.

→ Building the product team. First hires within 90 days. Roughly five PMs in 12 months. You'll set the bar.

→ Carrying the product story. Internally to leadership, externally to partners, candidates, and the press. The story matters as much as the product.

03

Who we're looking for

The best product leaders we've worked with don't reach for a 2x2 when the road forks. They look at the product, the users, the team — and they have a view. They hold it well. They change it when the evidence shifts. They don't perform conviction. They have it.

They've also never stopped doing the work. They write the spec, they sit in the user interview, they sketch the flow, they argue the metric definition. The title says "lead" but the day-to-day says "builder."

Must-have

→ Built consumer products people use repeatedly. Mobile-first, high-frequency, habit-forming products are ideal.

→ Strong product judgment across insight, UX, metrics, and prioritisation. You can move from user conversations to flows to cohort reads to roadmap calls without outsourcing the hard thinking.

→ Early-stage product instincts. You know the difference between optimising a working funnel and finding the wedge before the funnel exists.

→ Hands-on builder energy. You can write a sharp spec, sketch a flow, run a user interview, define an experiment, and make the call when signal is messy.

→ Ability to build the product function. You've hired, mentored, or raised the bar for PMs before — even if the team was small.

→ Built inside a startup. You've operated in a small, fast-paced team where speed, ambiguity, and direct ownership were the defaults. You don't need structure to do your best work — you create it.

Strong signals

→ You've built a product where growth came from the product loop itself, not just paid marketing.

→ You understand Indian consumer behaviour — especially how young people, couples, flatmates, and families coordinate money.

→ You've worked on social, fintech, commerce, payments, or other coordination-heavy products.

→ You've operated in a regulated or high-trust environment.

→ You use AI tools every day to increase the leverage of a small team.

→ You have unusually strong taste in product, copy, interaction design, and consumer storytelling.

Not required

→ A fintech background.

→ A big-company product title.

→ Experience managing a large PM org.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager for our AI Platform to drive the execution and delivery of Aurigo's proprietary AI foundation model, agent framework, and the AI platform layer that powers our products. This is a hands-on product role that operates at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise software, and capital program workflows. You will partner closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to define, build, and ship AI capabilities that are safe, measurable, and impactful in enterprise environments. Unlike the Director role which is focused on strategy, vision, and stakeholder leadership, this role is about deep execution. You will own specific product areas end to end, write detailed requirements, drive sprint-level delivery, and ensure that AI products meet well-defined quality and safety standards before reaching customers. You will also engage with customers and internal product teams to ground your decisions in real-world use cases.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the product roadmap for assigned areas of the AI platform, including the ingestion and context layer, orchestration layer, agent framework components, and the Copilot experience across all product lines.
  • Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI features, and drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking in close partnership with engineering and machine learning teams.
  • Define and maintain the evaluation framework for assigned AI features including offline evals, benchmark metrics, regression tests, and production monitoring. No agent or model capability ships without defined success criteria.
  • Own the responsible AI execution process at the feature level, including guardrail testing, safety checklists, bias review, and auditability verification before any AI capability reaches customers.
  • Serve as the internal AI platform expert for Senior Product Managers across all product lines, providing guidance on how to correctly integrate, specify, and evaluate AI capabilities within their respective workflows.
  • Contribute to the model management and MCP server roadmap by gathering data on provider performance, cost, and quality, and by identifying integration opportunities and validating tool specifications.
  • Engage with enterprise customers to gather feedback on AI feature performance, understand adoption patterns, and translate insights into roadmap decisions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape for relevant AI product developments, agent frameworks, and enterprise AI tooling, and bring insights into prioritization discussions.


Soft Skills

  • Technically credible with engineering and data science teams. Can engage substantively on prompt design, evaluation tradeoffs, RAG configurations, and agent behavior without needing to write code.
  • Clear and precise communicator. Able to write requirements, specs, and documentation that engineering teams can act on without repeated clarification.
  • Customer empathy. Listens carefully to enterprise customer feedback and translates nuanced qualitative input into actionable product decisions.
  • High ownership mindset. Takes accountability for feature quality, safety, and customer outcomes, not just delivery of scope.
  • Structured problem-solver. Breaks ambiguous AI product challenges into well-defined hypotheses, experiments, and evaluation plans.
  • Stays current with fast-moving developments in foundation models, agentic architectures, and enterprise AI deployment patterns.


Hard Skills

  • Strong understanding of the AI product development lifecycle including data pipelines, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine-tuning, and agentic system design.
  • Experience designing and running AI evaluation frameworks including offline evals, human evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring for AI features.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles including human-in-the-loop design, fairness considerations, auditability, and guardrail implementation in enterprise settings.
  • Working knowledge of model context protocol or equivalent tool-use and integration frameworks for agentic systems.
  • Ability to define and track AI-specific product metrics including task completion rates, hallucination rates, model latency, cost per inference, and user satisfaction signals.


Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with major foundation model providers and the practical tradeoffs among them in terms of capability, cost, latency, context window, and data privacy.
  • Working knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, and embedding-based retrieval systems relevant to RAG product design.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation tooling such as LLM eval libraries, RAGAS, or equivalent frameworks for measuring AI system performance.
  • Understanding of AI orchestration patterns including ReAct loops, multi-agent coordination, and durable workflow execution for long-running agent tasks.
  • Proficiency with standard product management tools alongside AI-specific development and observability platforms.


Educational Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. Advanced degree in a relevant discipline is an advantage.


Prior Experience

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in product management, with at least 2 to 3 years owning AI or machine learning product features in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI features to production in enterprise contexts, including agents, copilots, predictive models, or recommendation systems.
  • Hands-on experience defining evaluation criteria and running evals for AI features, including benchmark design, human evaluation coordination, and production quality tracking.
  • Experience working directly with data science and machine learning engineering teams on model prototyping, prompt iteration, or deployment workflows.
  • Background in infrastructure, construction, capital program management, or other complex enterprise domains is a strong advantage.


About Aurigo

Aurigo provides AI-native platforms that help capital owners connect planning, construction, and operations in a single environment, improving decision-making and execution. Trusted by over 300 organizations across federal, state, and local government, manufacturing, data centers, energy and utilities, and life sciences, we manage more than $450 billion in capital programs across 40,000+ projects in North America. Built on 20+ years of domain expertise, Aurigo has received multiple industry awards and has been certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.


At Aurigo, we go beyond building technology—we shape the future. If you're excited to join a fast-growing company and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry to solve real-world challenges, let's connect.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with the use of AI for automation.
  • Experience in navigating product and technology trade-offs.
  • Experience leading products while understanding the end user habits.
  • Experience in a fast-paced environment with nuances of managing high traffic, serving binaries, and making product fundamentals.
  • Experience working with technical product leaders and senior engineers, with the ability to influence resourcing, tech, and product decisions.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, the team is responsible for ensuring that Search delivers on its goals of latency, capacity, and reliability.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Define ideas and execute key goals for search serving binaries and ML infrastructure in collaboration with engineering leadership.
  • Meet the high-compute demands of next-generation AI features.
  • Drive full automation of search binary operations using AI to minimize manual toil.
  • Anticipate future infrastructure needs and manage cross-functional partnerships to build a resilient, future-proof search stack.
  • Build knowledge to bridge the gap between user-centric feature teams and infrastructure reliability.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

  • Take full ownership of and continuously enhance the product roadmap for the Academics vertical, encompassing aspects such as attendance, timetabling, curriculum management, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules
  • Prioritize features and improvements by integrating customer feedback, usage analytics, and current higher education institutional trends
  • Effectively balance immediate customer demands with the long-term vision for the platform, ensuring that all decisions support our growth goals
  • Lead regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty members, and students from partner institutions to identify pain points and unmet requirements
  • Evaluate product usage data, support inquiries, and market insights to uncover gaps and new opportunities for products within the academics vertical
  • Collaborate closely with customer success and sales teams to incorporate the customer’s perspective into every sprint and planning session
  • Convert complex academic workflows into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user stories that engineering and design teams can confidently implement
  • Facilitate agile processes including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts across design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to guarantee smooth launches of new features
  • Track adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics following product launches and rapidly iterate based on data and user feedback
  • Maintain a well-organized product backlog, prioritizing tasks that have the greatest impact
  • Serve as the main product liaison for academic module stakeholders, both internally (sales, customer success, engineering) and externally (institutional administrators and faculty)
  • Consistently communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release schedules clearly to leadership and cross-functional team members



Requirements
Must Haves

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in product management within enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a proven history of delivering B2B SaaS products from start to finish
  • Demonstrated capability to independently manage a product vertical—from initial discovery and roadmap development through execution and post-launch refinement
  • Deep understanding of academic workflows in higher education, including timetabling, curriculum management, learning management systems, attendance, and student lifecycle processes
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, comfortable utilizing product analytics tools and translating data into actionable product enhancements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams around a unified product vision
  • Practical experience working in agile environments, conducting sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs



Good to Have

  • Previous experience collaborating with Indian higher education institutions such as universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms like Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary systems, as well as academic ERP solutions
  • Experience using product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or equivalents
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Figma
  • Background in working with customer-facing teams—including sales, support, and customer success—to collect and act upon institutional feedback
  • A passion for the education sector and a sincere interest in enhancing outcomes for students and academic institutions



Must-have skills

Product Manager, Product Roadmapping, SaaS

Good-to-have skills

B2B, LMS, ERP

descriptionHtml:
About Delhivery One

Delhivery One is the operating system for India’s SMB and D2C shippers — the single platform through which more than 45,000 SMB and D2C shippers manage their end-to-end logistics every month, for both domestic and international shipping. From creating B2C and B2B orders and managing pickups, to tracking NDRs and RTOs, settling COD remittances, disputing weight mismatches, filing lost and damaged claims, and activating value-added services — Delhivery One handles the full shipper lifecycle across domestic, cross-border, and intracity shipping.

Beyond core shipping, we’ve been doing some exciting work building AI-native value-added services directly on top of Delhivery’s network — things that only work because they’re inside the network, not bolted on from outside. There’s a lot more to build here, and we’d love to have you be part of it.

We are building the best B2B product experience in India for SMB and D2C shippers, and we are doing it AI-first.


The Role

You will own a significant product surface on Delhivery One — spanning core shipper workflows (order management, NDR, finances, claims) and the AI-native value-added services that sit on top of them. Your job is to make both layers exceptional: workflows that are fast, clear, and nearly effortless for an SMB shipper; and AI services that work reliably at scale and get better over time.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define what you build, why, and to what standard — and you will be accountable for the outcomes.


What You Will Do:

Own the shipper experience end-to-end

Define what great looks like for your product area across the full SMB shipper journey — first ship, daily operations, exception handling, billing, claims resolution. Work closely with Design and Engineering to raise the craft bar on every flow. Notice when a workflow has one step too many. Push for better.

Build and ship AI-native features

Design features where AI is the primary mechanism — not a layer bolted on after. Ship them to production, instrument them, and iterate based on real data. Understand confidence thresholds, fallback design, and how to evaluate model quality as a PM.

Set outcome metrics and own them

Define success before you build — activation rate, AI resolution rate, shipper effort score, claim resolution TAT. Treat these as seriously as the features themselves.

Lead cross-functional execution

Drive alignment across Design, Engineering, Finance, Ops, and Business. Write specs that engineers can act on and that leadership can evaluate. Move fast without losing precision.


Is This You?

You have an ownership bias.

When something is broken, you fix it — you don’t wait for someone to assign it to you. You treat the product as if it’s yours, because it is. You follow up, you close loops, and you hold the bar even when no one is watching.

You have an urgency bias.

You move faster than the average PM. You know the difference between “needs more thought” and “we’re overthinking this.” You bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating over waiting for perfect information.

You can go deep without losing the picture.

You can sit in a claims escalation review and understand the edge cases — and then step back and articulate the strategic bet. You don’t get lost in details, and you don’t hide behind strategy to avoid them. You do both.

You have shipped AI-native product work.

Not prototypes. Not internal tools. Features in production where AI is the primary mechanism — and you can talk about what worked, what didn’t, and how you measured it. You understand confidence thresholds, fallback design, and human-in-the-loop tradeoffs.

You have craft for user experience.

You have an aesthetic. You give sharp design feedback and you act on it. You notice when an error message blames the user, when an empty state is a missed opportunity, or when a flow has one step too many — and you do something about it.

You write well.

Your specs don’t require a meeting to understand. You can write a one-pager for a founder and a detailed flow for an engineer, and both leave with clarity.

If this is you, you will thrive here.


What We Are Looking For

4–7 years in Product Management. You have shipped at least one product that real users rely on daily, and you can tell a clear story about the decisions that made it work.

Domain comfort with B2B or logistics complexity is a plus, but not required. What is required is the ability to get up to speed fast — by talking to SMB shippers, digging into ops workflows, and building mental models quickly.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We are looking for a customer-obsessed, analytics-driven Lead Product Manager to shape the future of our digital experience and commerce platform used by airlines as their primary web channel for customer engagement, shopping, booking, servicing, and post-purchase experiences.

This role will lead initiatives focused on building a platform thats highly customizable by our customers, customer experience, integrations, and scalable commerce capabilities. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, delivery and external customer stakeholders to deliver highly configurable, enterprise-grade solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management skills with the ability to drive alignment across complex programs and customer-facing initiatives.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive product roadmap and execution for digital commerce and customer experience capabilities.
  • Lead modernization initiatives across integrations and extensibility frameworks
  • Partner closely with engineering, architects, external customer and delivery teams to deliver scalable and configurable platform capabilities
  • Drive roadmap prioritization balancing customer needs, scalability, technical investment, and delivery timelines
  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear product requirements, epics, and user stories
  • Lead customer and stakeholder discussions to align on roadmap, priorities, and delivery strategy
  • Identify delivery risks early and drive mitigation planning across cross-functional teams
  • Support strategic customer engagements, solutioning discussions, and product positioning initiatives
  • Influence long-term platform and ecosystem strategy in partnership with engineering leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS, digital commerce, platform products, or related technology domains
  • Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and scalable platform architectures
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across business and technical teams
  • Experience leading large-scale modernization or transformation initiatives
  • Strong UX and customer journey mindset with experience partnering deeply with design and research teams
  • Strong experience using analytics and experimentation to drive product decisions and improve conversion, engagement, or operational metrics
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level communication
  • Strong analytical and prioritization skills with experience balancing roadmap scope, timelines, and technical constraints
  • Experience working in Agile product development environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in travel, hospitality, loyalty, or other transaction-heavy digital platforms
  • Familiarity with configurable or white-label platform models
  • Experience building platform capabilities used by enterprise customers or external developers
  • Understanding of modern commerce ecosystems and customer experience platforms

Why Join Us

You’ll have the opportunity to shape a highly scalable digital platform used by airline customers globally. This role offers significant ownership, cross-functional leadership exposure, and the ability to influence the future direction of a modern commerce ecosystem.

Description

Amazon Subscribe and Save (SnS) is seeking a product leader to shape SnS’ customer experience product strategy by defining and building Customer-facing experiences across Amazon.com. SnS’ vision is to be the most valued and trusted reorder program in the world, improving customers’ lives by saving them time and money. SnS has grown rapidly, and we are expanding the program across new technologies and customer needs. Millions of customers depend on SnS today, and the experiences you build will enable SnS to serve millions more.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will develop a long-term roadmap of ideas that enhance customers’ interactions with SnS, assisting them in automating their purchases of everyday essentials and building features that make SnS more flexible and intelligent. We own the end-to-end customer experience, from discovery of SnS on Amazon.com all the way to package delivery. As a result, SnS Product Managers build features across the full Amazon.com shopping journey, giving you exposure to many different customer problems and software stacks. You will work with a dedicated team of SnS Software Engineers, User Experience Designers, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Data Scientists who will help bring your ideas to life. You will also design features that support easy reordering outside of SnS.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong product management background, demonstrate a passion for working on behalf of customers, have a track record of partnering with engineering teams to deliver large-scale projects, and have the ability to operate independently and autonomously. This candidate will be able to navigate ambiguity and set a clear vision for how to build an engaging SnS experience that customers love.

Customers are shifting their purchases of everyday essentials online and are increasingly relying on product subscription services in the process. SnS is at the forefront of both of these customer trends – come join us in simplifying the shopping experience for customers around the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in product management within enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a proven history of delivering B2B SaaS products from start to finish

Good to Have

  • Previous experience collaborating with Indian higher education institutions such as universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges

  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Figma
  • Background in working with customer-facing teams—including sales, support, and customer success—to collect and act upon institutional feedback
  • A passion for the education sector and a sincere interest in enhancing outcomes for students and academic institutions

Product Manager, Product Roadmapping, SaaS

Good-to-have Skills

B2B, LMS, ERP

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

  • Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
  • Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
  • Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
  • Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
  • Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
  • Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
  • Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
  • Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

Qualifications

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
  • Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
  • Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
  • Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
  • A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
  • Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

Additional Information

About the Group/Team

Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.

In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.

About The Role/Specialty

As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.

This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

About Swiggy Instamart

Swiggy Instamart, is building the convenience grocery segment in India. We offer more than 40000 items to our customers within 10-15 mins. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by making grocery delivery instant and delightful.
