Job Description: Sr. Manager – New Product Development (NPD) & Quality

Role: Senior Manager - Subject Matter Expert for Munchies & Snacks, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Chocolates-Confectionary, Breakfast cereals & Emerging Categories

Role Objective

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Manager – Product Development & Quality to lead end-to-end development and quality assurance across Snacking, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Breakfast Cereals, and Emerging Categories within our private label portfolio.

As the Sr. Manager – NPD & Quality, This role will serve as the technical backbone for product range expansion, transforming traditional flavors into scalable, high-quality offerings. This role bridges culinary expertise with food science, ensuring every product meets our highest standards of quality, safety, and consistency. Drive trend-led innovation while upholding world-class product quality and robust food safety standards across all categories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Innovation

End-to-End Development: Lead the formulation of a diverse portfolio including Namkeen, Extruded Snacks, Energy Bars, and Confectionary.

Traditional Modernization: Adapt Indian Sweets, Chikki, and Traditional Foods for modern retail without losing authentic "homemade" soul.

Clean Label Initiative: Work to reduce artificial additives, moving toward natural preservatives in Chutneys and Spreads.

Health & Wellness: Drive innovation in Emerging Categories like high-protein Energy Bars, Clean-Label Spreads, and Whole-Grain Breakfast Cereals.

Develop and optimize recipes/formulations aligned to target cost, quality, and shelf-life

Drive innovation based on market trends, competitor benchmarking, and consumer insights

Conduct trials (lab & plant scale) and ensure successful commercialization

  • Quality Assurance & Standardization

Define product specifications, SOPs, and quality benchmarks for all SKUs

Establish sensory, physical, and microbiological quality parameters

Conduct supplier audits, product evaluations, and ensure batch-to-batch consistency

Implement quality improvement initiatives and root cause analysis for deviations

  • Supplier Management & Capability Building

Identify, Audit, onboard, and develop suppliers/vendors

Work closely with manufacturers to ensure adherence to product specs and process controls

Drive vendor performance through audits, scorecards, and continuous improvement plans

  • Regulatory & Compliance

Ensure compliance with FSSAI and other applicable food safety standards

Validate label claims, nutritional information, and ingredient declarations

Support regulatory documentation and approvals for new product launches

  • Cost Optimization & Productivity

Drive value engineering initiatives without compromising quality

Optimize formulations, ingredients, and processes to meet cost targets

Support scale-up efficiency and wastage reduction initiatives

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations for seamless launches

Align with packaging and logistics teams for shelf-life and stability considerations

Support customer feedback analysis and continuous product improvement.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic Product Development: Ability to build and drive NPD pipeline across categories, translating consumer insights and traditional recipes into scalable, commercially viable products.

Food Science & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of ingredients, processing technologies, shelf-life, and formulation across snacks, sweets, and cereals.

Quality & Food Safety Leadership: Deep knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP/GHP with the ability to establish robust quality systems and ensure compliance across vendors.

Scale-up & Commercialization: Proven capability in moving products from lab to plant scale, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and speed-to-market.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management: Strong experience in vendor development, audits, and cross-functional collaboration (Procurement, Ops, Marketing, Supply Chain).

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering: Ability to balance cost, quality, and performance through formulation and process optimization.

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Strong root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement mindset.

Innovation & Market Orientation: Ability to identify trends, benchmark competition, and drive differentiated product offerings.

Leadership & Team Management: Capability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions and partners.

Execution Excellence: High ownership with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Travel requirement

This role requires extensive travel (~20–30%) across multiple cities and supplier locations.

Travel will be primarily for product development trials, plant validations, supplier onboarding, audits, and quality alignment.

The candidate should be comfortable working closely with manufacturing partners on-site to drive faster commercialization and consistent quality execution.

Qualifications & Experience

B.Tech / M.Tech in Food Technology/ Food Science with 10 years in R&D/NPD and Quality Assurance within the FMCG or Food Retail sector.

Experience In FMCG, QSR, Or Private Label Business Preferred

Ability to balance "the best recipe" with "the best COGS" (Cost of Goods Sold).

descriptionHtml:
About Us
QuillBot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, QuillBot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.

Role Overview
Now we’re building a full AI-powered creation platform that supports them from the first spark of an idea to a finished, shareable piece of work.

The creation suite is a key pillar of this evolution, the space where users can transform their words into visually compelling assets: presentations, campaigns, PDFs, social posts, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this effort and shape the future of how people create with QuillBot.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the creation suite from MVP to a flagship QuillBot product—driving the roadmap, success metrics, and user experience.
  • Own the end-to-end user journey for visual creation—from ideation to layout to export.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, marketing, brand, SEO and researchers to turn text and ideas into adaptive, multimodal outputs.
  • Define and validate workflows, templates, and design systems that make non-designers feel like creators.
  • Collaborate closely with the Writing and Chat product teams to ensure seamless handoffs between idea, draft, and design.
  • Use data, research, and product intuition to balance user delight, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod toward measurable outcomes—traffic, engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Qualification 

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building/growing creation or design-centric products.
  • A track record of taking consumer-facing tools from 0→1 or 1→N, ideally with products in the creative or productivity space.
  • Experience in AI-assisted or automation-heavy workflows—text-to-image, auto-layout, or generative creation—is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of UX for creative tools and empathy for non-technical users.
  • Strong design sensibility—you understand layout, visual hierarchy, and what makes creation feel effortless.
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across design, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

What You Can Expect to Do in Your 180 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

  • Deep-dive into QuillBot’s creation platform vision, user personas, and current MVP.
  • Understand the existing creation suite experience, performance metrics, and user pain points.
  • Conduct a competitive benchmarking.
  • Build strong partnerships with Design, Engineering, and AI/UX Research leads.
  • Align on near-term success metrics and team priorities.

30-90 Days: Define & Prioritize

  • Craft a clear roadmap for post-MVP development—defining which workflows, templates, and features matter most.
  • Lead early experiments in user experience, template expansion, and AI-assisted creation.
  • Establish analytics and feedback loops for measuring product success.
  • Partner with marketing and growth to position the creation suite within QuillBot’s ecosystem.

90–180 Days—Execute & Scale

  • Launch new workflows or features that significantly improve user creation speed and output quality.
  • Define and validate the long-term strategy for multimodal, brand-aware creation.
  • Drive engagement growth and user retention through data-backed iteration.
  • Build the foundation for QuillBot’s primary visual creation surface.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own one of the most impactful growth and experimentation surfaces at QuillBot.
  • Shape how millions of users discover and first experience QuillBot.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, growth, and product systems.
  • Collaborate with a team that values speed, learning, and thoughtful product decisions.
  • Be a key driver of QuillBot’s transition from individual tools to a cohesive creation platform.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to QuillBot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

This role is eligible for hire in India.

We are a virtual-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations 

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements

title: Principal Product Manager
description: Life at UiPathThe people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.Could that be you?Your missionYou'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform - agents, workflows, and RPA - depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.This is a hands-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.The platform you'll shapeYou'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.Data Fabric - the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.Human-in-the-Loop - the human-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

You'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform - agents, workflows, and RPA - depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.

This is a hands-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.

The platform you'll shape

You'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.

  • Data Fabric - the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.
  • Human-in-the-Loop - the human-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. The work ahead: making it first-class for the agentic era.

What You'll Do At UiPath

  • Own the vision and roadmap for your platform layer, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems, and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
  • Drive go-to-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
  • Be the customer's champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
  • Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value (e.g. production adoption, task success rate, agent reliability).
  • Get technical. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
  • Make it agent-ready. Translate the fast-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
  • Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring.

What You'll Bring To The Team

  • 8+ years of product management on technical / platform / developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
  • A builder's instinct. You've shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you'd rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
  • Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
  • Hands-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work. Building products for - and with - agents is a fundamental expectation.
  • A genuine customer-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
  • GTM drive. You've created demand and driven adoption, not just delivered features - and you can tell a clear "why" and "what" story to any audience.
  • Crisp, decision-rich communication and the ability to influence across engineering, design, sales, and marketing without authority.
  • Bias to ownership and action - you take ambiguous, high-stakes problems and drive them to a result with minimal direction.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with data platforms or human-in-the-loop / workflow systems.
  • Built or shipped products in the agentic / AI space.
  • Background that combines engineering and product.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

Description

Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable Financial systems and infrastructure that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top finance and engineering talent get you charged up? If so, Amazon Finance Technology (FinTech) is for you!

Amazon FinTech is looking for a Senior Product Manager Technical (PM-T) to deliver long term scalable product that will help our Accounting and Finance customers improve financial reconciliations processes, accelerate financial close cycle, enhance controllership and reduce manual effort through automation.

We are seeking an experienced, results-oriented, self-motivated Technical Product Manager, having a bent for solving complex problems and delivering high quality technical products. You will be responsible for developing product strategy, defining product requirements working with global internal accounting teams, influencing stakeholders and engineering teams required to deliver an impactful product.

The ideal candidate for this role will have strong ownership, business and product sense combined with a solid understanding of financial and accounting concepts. You will need to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment without being hindered by ambiguity. High judgment, ability to influence, analytical talent, exceptional communications, the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders and leadership are essential to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define product requirements and execution strategy for an enterprise product
  • Lead the product life cycle including vision, strategy, roadmap, requirements, user experience, delivery, launch, and support.
  • Work with engineering, research, UX, technical program managers and stakeholders to deliver a successful product
  • Collaborate with Amazon partner tech teams to ensure product re-usability and avoid redundancies.
  • Managing both upwards and downwards communications effectively

About The Team

FinTech’s charter is to enable Finance & Global Business Services (FGBS) teams, and amplify the benefit of FGBS teams to support the growth, expansion, and restructuring of the businesses. The Close Systems team owns coordination, execution and continuous improvement for month close processes across FGBS teams. We own developing automation to scale with Amazon’s growth, reduce manual effort and defects, streamline processes, and drive accountability across teams. The Close Systems team improves the financial close by developing automation to scale with Amazon’s growth, reduce manual effort and defects, streamline processes, and drive accountability across teams.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

descriptionHtml:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

CT Senior Product Delivery Manager - Associate Director

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help build a better working world.

The opportunity

The selected candidate will

  • The Senior Product Delivery Manager will bring a strong understanding of modern software engineering principles and architecture. While not expected to code daily, the TPM should have prior experience working closely with engineers, solution architects, and data specialists. They will able to translate complex technical concepts into actionable deliverables.
  • Be responsible for identifying, handling and executing product strategies for their function
  • The Senior PDM will interact with individuals up to the Partner rank socializing, identifying and recommending products
  • This role is a primary contact and lead for all product aspects including strategy, user experience design, development, and deployment
  • The role will continuously evaluate and validate product vision to anticipate and address changing business and user needs
  • The role has accountability for value delivery and budget adherence. Ensuring that resources, services, and delivery outcomes align with agreed value metrics and budget parameters.
  • This role is responsible for helping to find opportunities for products to align to the firm’s broader organizational mission and strategy and that it is competitively positioned driving revenue and EY’s technological footprint in the market
  • This role will require a solid understanding of Azure-based architectures, data and AI platforms (e.g., Databricks, M365 integrations), and modern DevOps practices to ensure effective collaboration across globally distributed development teams.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Within large projects, define and maintain realistic delivery plans, ensuring disciplined software lifecycle management across analysis, design, development, testing, and release. Drive adherence to quality gates, change control, and CI/CD processes.
  • This position is a leadership position responsible for defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a sophisticated product or a set of products within a product family
  • Manage a mid-size team of product professionals, as well as roles across a software delivery lifecycle, such as architects, engineers, scrum masters etc
  • Provide matrix leadership and coaching to Business Analysts to ensure user stories are well-structured, technically feasible, and meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards. Establish and enforce story quality standards and backlog readiness criteria.
  • This leadership position is responsible for thought leadership ensuring the product supports the organization’s overall strategy and goals
  • Outstanding leadership with the ability to communicate the vision and goals of the product, product family, and offerings
  • Drive strategy development, establish priorities and manage the roadmap using criteria and requirements defined during research
  • Act as the customer advocate articulating the user’s and/or buyer’s needs
  • Work closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and support to ensure business case and customer satisfaction goals are met
  • Have technical product knowledge or specific domain expertise
  • Define what to solve in the market needs document, where you articulate the valuable market problem you’re solving along with priorities and justification for each part of the solution
  • Align with business teams on MVP requirements, run beta and pilot programs during the qualify phase
  • In Agile environments, regularly reviews completed work and checks with customers to ensure that it meets the customer expectations
  • Is a market professional. Market expertise includes understanding the reasons customers purchase products. This includes a deep understanding of the competition, and how customers think of and buy your product. Product Managers need market research and competitive analysis skills to complete these tasks
  • Acts as the product’s leader within the company
  • Develops the business case for new products, improvements to existing products, and business ventures
  • Responsible for the development and positioning of 2-3 mid-size products or 1 large enterprise product that is global with responsibility for sophisticated customization. These products enable critical internal capabilities across the firm, supporting operational excellence and technology modernization objectives.
  • Recommends or requires an awareness of competitive pricing to understand how pricing impacts product profit margin compared to competition
  • Execute the product plan, collaborating with product owner, engineering and other teams
  • Translate architectural direction into incremental deliverables. Lead technical discovery and spike activities to reduce delivery risk and accelerate time-to-value. Work closely with solution architects to ensure technical feasibility and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Demonstrate functionality of completed products to partners
  • Develop metrics to assess the success of products and features and resolve vital enhancements
  • Anticipate changes in market dynamics/models, adapts products, and creates product retirement and transitioning strategies
  • Identify new products and features to create growth opportunities

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • A strong understanding of software engineering lifecycle principles, DevOps pipelines, and Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe) is essential. The TPM must be able to assess technical risks, interpret architecture decisions, and translate them into clear, testable, and deliverable work items.
  • Manage the product lifecycle including market requirements, product release plans, user stories, release criteria, product launch, and organizational readiness activities
  • Collect business and technical input to define and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with architecture and platform capabilities. Partner with the BPM and engineering to continuously refine and sequence backlog items for efficient sprint execution
  • Partner with internal customers to validate requirements and priorities through various forums (analysis, meetings, focus groups, etc) and refine those requirements for broad market applicability
  • Collaborate with user experience, business analysts and engineers with a focus on defining product functionality and designing solutions that bring differentiating value to our current and prospective clients
  • Supervise market changes and trends to assess competitive positioning and opportunities for strategic product enhancements
  • Provide regular updates about product direction and release plans to the senior partners and clients
  • Monitor and report on delivery metrics such as lead time, user story cycle time, bug density, and mean time to restore service (MTTR) to ensure delivery health and continuous improvement.

What We Look For

A technically fluent, outcome-driven product leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to engage deeply in delivery detail. Someone who can coach teams, manage complex technical dependencies, and drive clarity between business intent and engineering execution

A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion!

Preferred Certifications And Experience

  • Microsoft Azure or other cloud certifications (e.g., AZ-900, AZ-104, or equivalent)
  • Professional Product Management (e.g., SAFe POPM, CSPO, PSPO)
  • Agile or DevOps certifications (e.g., Scrum Master, DevOps Foundation)
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines for software delivery

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product roadmap established by the Product Management leadership team and meet business objectives. The person in this position manages multiple teams and backlogs for more than one product and/or for more complex products. This role is responsible for defining the detailed product deliverables. The Senior Product Owner must have a firm understanding of the business domain and product needs taking into account multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile teams have all of the information needed to deliver a product that provides maximum value to the users.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to understand the market demands, priorities, and overall product strategy.
  • Partner with UX and Product Managers on market research efforts to understand and prioritize customer needs.
  • Work with one or more engineering teams to deliver timely, quality releases that provide high business value and exceed customer expectations.
  • Flexibility to support more than one product within a portfolio, potentially across value streams
  • Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
  • Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
  • Understand user personas and partner with UX to develop
  • Create detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.
  • Write user stories and establish acceptance criteria in collaboration with the team.
  • Actively participate in PI planning, product sprints and daily stand-up meetings
  • Research and clarify details as the team develops the application
  • Be aware of customer commitments in order to communicate internally to assist with managing team expectations
  • Manage dependencies in and across sprints and releases
  • Work with the Agile team to manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure alignment with changing business needs.
  • Prioritize support work as needed
  • Assist with system status communication and escalation as needed including customer communication
  • Perform demos to all stakeholders on a regular basis
  • Keep stakeholders apprised of progress and incorporate their feedback
  • Understand project budgets, scope and timelines and work to maintain a balance
  • Use metrics and feedback to improve team and organization processes, best practices, performance, and delivery
  • May provide work direction or guidance to colleagues with less experience
  • Act as a product champion within the company

Skills Required

descriptionHtml:
About Learneo
Learneo is a platform of builder-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

Role Overview
Now we’re building a full AI-powered creation platform that supports them from the first spark of an idea to a finished, shareable piece of work.

The creation suite is a key pillar of this evolution, the space where users can transform their words into visually compelling assets: presentations, campaigns, PDFs, social posts, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this effort and shape the future of how people create with Quillbot.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the creation suite from MVP to a flagship Quillbot product—driving the roadmap, success metrics, and user experience.
  • Own the end-to-end user journey for visual creation—from ideation to layout to export.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, marketing, brand, SEO and researchers to turn text and ideas into adaptive, multimodal outputs.
  • Define and validate workflows, templates, and design systems that make non-designers feel like creators.
  • Collaborate closely with the Writing and Chat product teams to ensure seamless handoffs between idea, draft, and design.
  • Use data, research, and product intuition to balance user delight, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod toward measurable outcomes—traffic, engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Qualification 

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building/growing creation or design-centric products.
  • A track record of taking consumer-facing tools from 0→1 or 1→N, ideally with products in the creative or productivity space.
  • Experience in AI-assisted or automation-heavy workflows—text-to-image, auto-layout, or generative creation—is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of UX for creative tools and empathy for non-technical users.
  • Strong design sensibility—you understand layout, visual hierarchy, and what makes creation feel effortless.
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across design, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

What You Can Expect to Do in Your 180 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

  • Deep-dive into Quillbot’s creation platform vision, user personas, and current MVP.
  • Understand the existing creation suite experience, performance metrics, and user pain points.
  • Conduct a competitive benchmarking.
  • Build strong partnerships with Design, Engineering, and AI/UX Research leads.
  • Align on near-term success metrics and team priorities.

30-90 Days: Define & Prioritize

  • Craft a clear roadmap for post-MVP development—defining which workflows, templates, and features matter most.
  • Lead early experiments in user experience, template expansion, and AI-assisted creation.
  • Establish analytics and feedback loops for measuring product success.
  • Partner with marketing and growth to position the creation suite within Quillbot’s ecosystem.

90–180 Days—Execute & Scale

  • Launch new workflows or features that significantly improve user creation speed and output quality.
  • Define and validate the long-term strategy for multimodal, brand-aware creation.
  • Drive engagement growth and user retention through data-backed iteration.
  • Build the foundation for Quillbot’s primary visual creation surface.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own one of the most impactful growth and experimentation surfaces at Quillbot.
  • Shape how millions of users discover and first experience Quillbot.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, growth, and product systems.
  • Collaborate with a team that values speed, learning, and thoughtful product decisions.
  • Be a key driver of Quillbot’s transition from individual tools to a cohesive creation platform.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to Quillbot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

This role is eligible for hire in India.

We are a virtual-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations 

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and ​inclusion within our company.  ​We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender ​identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, ​veteran status, or ​ability status. Please contact us to request accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for defining, delivering, and scaling core payment‑processing capabilities across global card‑present and card‑not‑present channels.

This role owns end‑to‑end product management for a defined set of payment platform capabilities, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment across gateways, processors, schemes, and downstream services. The Senior Manager partners closely with engineering, architecture, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and commercial teams to deliver high‑quality payment capabilities aligned with platform standards and regulatory requirements.

As a senior individual contributor, this role plays a key part in quarterly planning, roadmap execution, and cross‑team alignment within the Payment Processing Product Management organization and the broader Visa Acceptance Platform.

Payments Domain Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of payment acceptance, processing, and orchestration, including authorization, settlement, tokenization, network rules, and payment‑scheme behaviors
  • Experience working with acquiring, gateway processing, issuer behaviors, and optionality across payment rails (card, wallets, A2A, alternative payments)
  • Familiarity with fraud‑management concepts (e.g., 3DS, routing strategies) is highly desirable

Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

  • Contribute to and execute product strategy for assigned payment platform capabilities, including capability design and scaling considerations
  • Identify customer and market needs across merchants, PSPs, acquirers, and alternative payment methods
  • Translate customer, partner, and regulatory inputs into a clear, actionable roadmap/epic/features for payment flows and platform enhancements

Product Definition & Delivery

  • Define detailed product requirements, epics, features, process flows, and business rules for complex payment capabilities
  • Own cross‑functional readiness for assigned capabilities, including operational procedures, risk/compliance alignment, partner onboarding, and performance metrics
  • Participate in agile ceremonies as needed to ensure shared understanding and delivery against product goals
  • Ensure end‑to‑end payment experiences are well‑defined, including retries, fallbacks, routing logic, error handling, and user experience considerations

Data‑Driven Decision Making

  • Partner with analytics and operations teams to define KPIs, dashboards, and monitoring tools that support prioritization and performance tracking
  • Analyze trends such as authorization declines, fraud rates, routing effectiveness, and cost‑to‑serve to inform product improvements
  • Commercialization & Go‑to‑Market
  • Support development of value propositions, pricing inputs, merchant‑facing narratives, and readiness materials
  • Collaborate with sales, program management, finance, legal, compliance, UX, and partners to support go‑to‑market execution
  • Participate in merchant and partner engagements by clearly articulating product capabilities, differentiation, and roadmap direction

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 6 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • Minimum of 5 years of product management experience in payment processing domain and API‑based products.
  • Strong expertise in payments processing, including gateways, acquiring, scheme rules, lifecycle flows, and regulatory considerations
  • Experience defining API contracts, platform capabilities, and contributing to longer‑term product architecture decisions
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with a bias toward scalable, reusable product solutions

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.  Key Characteristics  Outcome-oriented mindset.  Strong ownership and accountability.  Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.  Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.  Coaching and mentoring mindset.

The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 6–9 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.
  • Led end-to-end requirements for at least 2 modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Product & Requirement Ownership

  • Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).
  • Document requirements in SDS.
  • Analyse and prioritize defects.
  • Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.
  • Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.
  • Attend daily stand-ups.
  • Conduct User Forums.
  • Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team.
  • Work as a core representative to project teams as needed.
  • Convert business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive end-to-end solution discussions across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
  • Perform impact analysis across modules, systems, and business processes.
  • Prioritize backlog items aligned to business outcomes and roadmap objectives.
  • Ensure traceability from business requirements to implementation and validation.
  • Support product roadmap execution and release planning.

AI-Enabled Responsibilities

  • Use AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, documentation, prioritization, and workshop preparation.
  • Use AI-assisted techniques for: story generation, acceptance criteria generation, process mapping, impact analysis, test scenario generation, SQL/query generation, knowledge retrieval, and defect analysis.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, feasibility, traceability, hallucinations, and bias.
  • Use AI-enabled insights to improve delivery efficiency and decision-making.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and AI-assisted delivery assets.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled ways of working within teams.
  • Apply responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, privacy, and human oversight.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
  • Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
  • Intermediate SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
  • Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
  • Techno-functional and business solutioning capability.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled delivery tools.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.

Key Characteristics

  • Outcome-oriented mindset.
  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
  • Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.
  • Coaching and mentoring mindset.

descriptionHtml:
Life at EvoluteIQ


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry-leading Technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self-driven, and collaborative.

People who not only want to be a part of a fast-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and caring—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


Could that be you?


Your Mission

Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble, and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a “dent in the universe”. Our core fabric is Innovation!


And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive for every day at EvoluteIQ.


To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge. We make the building of automations implemented for everyone, so that it is not a mystery for a few.


Would you like to join us on this journey?


We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our AI/ML feature within our platform. This role requires strong prior experience in AI/ML product development in a product-based environment, with at least 10+ years of hands on- product management experience.


What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:


End-to-End Feature Ownership

  • Own the complete lifecycle of AI/ML features from ideation to production release.
  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering, and data science teams.
  • Drive roadmap definition, prioritization, and delivery planning for AI/ML capabilities.
  • Ensure delivered features meet business objectives, quality benchmarks, and user needs.
  • Drive post release- assessment and iteration based on usage data and feedback.


Research & Requirements Gathering

  • Conduct research on AI/ML industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
  • Identify high-value use cases and business opportunities across domains.
  • Work closely with internal/external stakeholders to understand business problems and define scope.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable functional requirements and success metrics.
  • Evaluate feasibility, impact, and business value of proposed AI/ML features.
  • Stay informed about developments in Generative AI, LLMs, and emerging tools.


Documentation & Communication

  • Create comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), functional specifications, and workflows.
  • Write detailed user stories with acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
  • Maintain documentation on feature scope, functionality, limitations, design decisions, and usage guidelines.
  • Present feature proposals, roadmap updates, and delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Ensure alignment of product expectations across technical and business teams.


Engineering & Delivery Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, data science, UX, DevOps, QA, and architecture teams to deliver high quality- features.
  • Ensure seamless integration of AI/ML workflows and model lifecycle management.
  • Partner with data science to assess model fit, evaluation metrics, and deployment readiness.
  • Support delivery planning, grooming, sprint execution, and release cycles.
  • Coordinate go-to- market activities, enablement, and user training


What will you bring to the team?


  • 12+ years of hands-on product management experience, with proven ownership of AI/ML or GenAI product areas.
  • Prior experience working in a product company is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • ML lifecycle, inference, evaluations
  • MLOps processes, Data engineering concepts
  • LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering
  • Strong documentation skills — PRDs, user stories, specs, and roadmaps.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data science teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience with agile methodologies.


Good To Have:

  • Experience with low-code/no-code platforms or enterprise workflow systems.
  • Experience running experiments (A/B testing) or evaluating GenAI/ML models.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next-gen hyper-automation platform.
  • Work with a cross-disciplinary team in a fast-growing, innovation-driven environment.
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
  • A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.


We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is shaping the future of global digital video entertainment. Our vision is to delight streamers by offering the freshest, richest, and most defect-free catalog of content anywhere. We are looking for a data-savvy, strategic, and analytical Senior Product Manager to work on the Marketing Automation as part of AI Automation team. In this cross-functional role you will help define and execute the strategy for the products and services that drive various social media and marketing lifecycle automation. You will collaborate with data science, engineering, operations, other product managers, and executive teams to bring products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our platform capabilities.

The duties will include formulating a business vision for your product domain, gathering business and functional requirements from internal customers and end-users, and translating those requirements into technical specifications to build robust, scalable, and supportable solutions that work well with a range of complex systems. The PMT serves as the technical as well as the business lead throughout the entire development lifecycle including scoping, planning, conceptualizing, designing, testing, documenting, and shipping the product to the end customer keeping in mind issues around tech debt, scalability, performance and latency, and compatibility with technology and business goals.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define and execute toward the long-term strategy for the marketing lifecycle management
  • Work closely with AI scientists and engineering teams to prioritize and deliver the roadmap
  • Working closely with social media partners to analyze business trends and make data-backed decisions
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including other product managers, partner management, and leadership to influence and drive the long-term strategy
  • Create business requirements, develop solutions, and socialize them across functions and teams
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle

If you enjoy defining and delivering first-class customer experiences, working with AI and tech teams, and have a passion for video, come join us!

About The Team

Our vision is to be the world’s most reliable, fastest digital video catalog. We provide partners with the best way to distribute their content and streaming customers with a consistent, reliable experience that works in any device, anywhere.

Our Team

  • Is obsessed with making things work for the streaming customer and the content partner
  • Makes data-backed decisions
  • Encourages continuous growing by supporting each together
  • Builds trust across our organization through transparency and communication

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
  • 2+ years of end to end product delivery experience
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. Every restaurant is unique, and a restaurant's menu expresses its individual brand and product offerings. In our digital ordering products, a great menu serves as both a billboard and a roadmap to an excellent dining experience. It is the central hub for restaurant configuration—it determines what guests can order, how the dishes are presented and priced in different contexts, where they are routed for fulfillment, how they are prepared, whether the ingredients are still available, and how they are classified for reporting.

A menu is always evolving: kitchens create new dishes, managers experiment with pricing and presentation, and staff optimize the menu for restaurant operations. As our customers grow—from single-location cafés to enterprise brands with thousands of locations—so does the complexity of managing these changes consistently, confidently, and at scale.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Amazon is looking for a motivated product leader for the RoW Last mile product team. In this role, you will:

  • Define, design, launch and manage tech products related to last mile planning and execution in Quick Commerce space
  • Gather requirements and conceptualize a tech solution to solve a business problem.
  • Own and drive the product portfolio and product roadmap
  • Work with key stakeholders across various functions to define and launch a product.
  • Manage technical integration with amazon systems across retail, merchant, transportation operations & finance technologies and setup end-to-end operational, accounting, financial, taxation requirements, performance measurement and customer satisfaction related processes.
  • Launch and expand the product as per Amazon’s requirements while being responsible for all customer and merchant satisfaction, performance, compliance, accounting and financial related metrics.
  • Use customer and market feedback, competitive analysis, and business metrics to make informed decisions
  • Exhibit product expertise that connects, understands, and leverages company-wide assets and capabilities
  • Evaluate launch outcomes and reintegrate learning into the organization and product plan

This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, partner & operator experience; manage performance and measure, determine, then drive, any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgment and decision making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.

The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products with little information. She/he will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead large cross-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, fulfillment, and business leaders.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Master's degree or equivalent
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:
Description

Amazon India is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive delivery experience innovations as the India leader. This is a high-impact role with full ownership of initiatives that directly shape customer delivery experience and Amazon India's delivery economics across millions of orders. You will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for India-specific delivery experience innovations and you will drive adoption of both developed and under-development products to extract maximum value, partnering closely with partners across supply chain, operations, categories and engineering.

We are looking for a strong PM who can dive deep into promise systems, delivery operations, and customer experience, write detailed PRFAQs/PRDs, and deliver features in complex, ambiguous environments. Proficiency with AI-powered tools for rapid experimentation is highly valued. The role offers significant visibility with IES DEX leadership and IN stores leadership.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct responsibility for driving product adoption and value extraction across operations, supply chain, categories, and technology teams
  • Opportunity to leverage AI tools to accelerate product development cycles and experimentation velocity
  • Opportunity to drive India-specific innovations in delivery communication and promise systems
  • Significant cross-functional impact requiring strong stakeholder engagement and change management
  • Direct influence on customer delivery experience for millions of Amazon India customers
  • High visibility with senior leadership across India business and WW DEX teams

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of developed and under-development products to extract maximum value through strategic stakeholder engagement across operations, supply chain, categories, WW teams, and technology
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate experimentation cycles including rapid PRFAQ writing, prototype development, data analysis, and hypothesis validation
  • Use AI-powered tools to quickly iterate product concepts, create mockups, analyze customer feedback, and generate insights from operational data
  • Build and execute adoption strategies including training, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and change management to ensure products deliver intended business impact
  • Drive India-specific innovations to improve delivery experience, checkout experience and pricing/promotions strategy for millions of India customers.
  • Build deep understanding of promise systems and enable optimal ship option configurations to maximize utilization of available network capacity and capabilities
  • Define and track key performance indicators including delivery reliability metrics, intercept rates, revenue recovery, customer satisfaction, and product adoption rates

About The Team

As part of Amazon's India Delivery Experience (IN DEX) team, we work on some of the most challenging customer experience problems in India's complex delivery landscape. We partner with operations teams, supply chain, technology, business teams, and WW DEX to build innovative solutions that drive real impact on delivery reliability and customer satisfaction. With a focus on India-specific innovations, we translate customer pain points into robust, scalable products that deliver tangible value to customers and the Amazon India business.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Experience in using statistical analysis to identify issues or opportunities for improvement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience leading and defining requirements and driving these across diverse organizations
  • Proficiency with AI tools for rapid experimentation including PRFAQ writing, prototyping, data analysis, and insight generation. Demonstrated ability to use AI-powered tools to accelerate product development cycles and increase experimentation velocity
  • Ability to analyze large datasets; proficiency in SQL or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Senior Product Manager

(Telecom RIC and rApp)


Why should you choose us?


Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.


To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.


Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to approximately 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.


About the Role: Looking for an experienced Product Owner/Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and delivery of RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) platform and rApp. You will own the product backlog , roadmap, define use cases , solution with cross product owner and work closely with engineering, pre-sales, and customer teams to deliver measurable outcomes for Tier-1 and Tier-2 operators globally.


Mandatory Skills:

  • Telecom, Observability, 4G/5G, RAN , Core,
  • Cloud Infra
  • 4 years in product management (Minimum)
  • ORAN / RAN
  • RIC / Rapps / xapps


Key Responsibilities :


Product Strategy & Vision

  • Own and communicate the product roadmap for RIC platform and rApp
  • Define quarterly and annual product goals aligned with operator needs and market trends ]
  • Conduct market analysis and competitive benchmarking across vendors


Backlog & Delivery

  • Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog; translate operator requirements into detailed, sprint-ready user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Define and maintain requirement documentation, use case specifications, and technical annexes for customer requirements
  • Drive NPI (New Product Introduction) process end-to-end


Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work directly with telecom customers (MNOs/MVNOs) to gather requirements, run workshops, and validate solution designs
  • Support to Respond to RFPs/RFIs with technical solution proposals and use case documentation
  • Present product demos, quarterly reviews, and roadmap sessions to CTO/CIO-level stakeholders
  • Represent the product in partner and alliance discussions


Cross-functional Leadership

  • Act as the bridge between business stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams
  • Run sprint ceremonies — planning, review, retrospective — in an Agile/SAFe environment
  • Manage dependencies across platform teams (Fault Monitor , Performance Monitor, Configuration Manager, Network Topology ,Network Inventory )


Required Skills & Experience:


Domain Knowledge

  • 10+ years of experience in Telecom, Packet Core , Access , with at least 2 years in a Product Owner or Product Manager role
  • Domain Knowledge of Telecom , 4G/5G, RAN , Core, Cloud & Infra
  • Deep understanding of Telecom, ORAN , RIC , rApp , Fault Management, Performance Management (PM counters, KPIs), SLA monitoring
  • Hands-on knowledge of 5G RAN, Core, and Cloud-native network architectures
  • Familiarity with ORAN Standards , 3GPP standards. Knowledge of TMF API Standards Add on
  • Contribution to ORAN standard body Add on
  • Experience with operator environments — NOC, zero-touch operations, AIOps


Technical Proficiency

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments and cloud-native microservices architecture
  • Ability to read and contribute to HLD documents, API specs, and integration design docs
  • Familiar with Python , Go , C & any public Cloud


Product & Agile

  • Proven experience owning a product backlog in Jira and running Agile/SAFe delivery
  • Ability to write crisp user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specs
  • Experience with roadmap tools (ProductBoard, or similar)
  • Strong RFP/RFI response experience — technical writing and solution architecture narratives


Good to Have

  • Experience with AI/ML-based anomaly detection in network monitoring contexts
  • Knowledge of GC log analysis, crash dump management, or binary log processing
  • Prior experience with operator deployments across regions (APAC, Europe, North America)


Soft Skills

  • Strong executive communication — able to present confidently to C-level stakeholders
  • Ability to work across time zones with distributed engineering and customer teams
  • Data-driven decision making — comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and usage analytics
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; able to define structure in fast-moving product environments


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or Engineering
  • 10+ years total experience; 3+ years as PO/PM on a telecom software product
  • Certifications preferred: CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, TM Forum Framework

This role is ideal for someone who has operated at the intersection of telecom network operations and cloud-native software delivery — someone who speaks both 'operator NOC' and 'Kubernetes microservices' fluently.


RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

  • Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
  • Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
  • Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
  • Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
  • Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate.
