descriptionHtml:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team in a Hybrid capacity, reporting to the Director, Product Management within the Product Management department. You will drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the Zscaler DSPM product line at the forefront of the world’s cloud security leader. By joining our team of innovation champions, you will deliver a growing portfolio of capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, and business enablement while shaping the future product roadmap.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the vision and lifecycle for specific modules within the Zscaler DSPM suite, ensuring the roadmap is agile and aligned with Zscaler’s high-level business priorities and market trends
  • Translate complex market needs into detailed technical requirements, providing clear needs to Engg teams to build high-performance features meeting acceptance criteria
  • Partner with other teams to navigate the development lifecycle, removing roadblocks and adjusting requirements for timely delivery
  • Act as the subject matter expert by analyzing the competitive landscape, identifying growth opportunities, and neutralizing threats through informed, data-driven product pivots
  • Drive product adoption by collaborating with Marketing and Sales on GTM plans and engaging with customers for roadmap presentations, feedback loops, and high-level escalations


Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bridge the gap between technical and business audiences, communicating complex concepts to internal teams, executives, and customers
  • 3–5 years of dedicated experience in Enterprise Product Management, specifically within the Cybersecurity or Information Security domains
  • Proven experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and data classification products with understanding of legacy tools and modern AI-based classification methods
  • Deep knowledge of Cloud Security products (commercial and CSP-native) and unique security challenges inherent to cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience and technical working knowledge of at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Knowledge of Cloud Posture Security Management (CSPM), auto-remediation, activity analytics, cloud-native API’s, security frameworks and compliance standards
  • Technical degree or a background in hands-on engineering, providing the architectural depth needed to lead complex product modules
  • Prior success in roles such as Escalation Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Deployment Services


At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!


Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

Job Title: Senior Manager – PM

Experience: 10+ years

Location: Bangalore (On-site)


Role Summary

You will be part of the Product Management team for the Lending portfolio, with a strong focus on Loan Management and Servicing platforms. This role involves working closely with the Product Director, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to design, build, and enhance scalable lending products used by banks and financial institutions globally.

Your primary responsibility will be to own and evolve product capabilities across the loan lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, configurability, and superior customer experience. You will translate complex lending domain requirements into clear product roadmaps and deliverables.


What Will You Do?

  • Define and execute product vision and roadmap for loan management systems aligned with business and market needs.
  • Own key lending modules including loan servicing, interest & fee management, repayments, collections, restructuring, and closures.
  • Act as the domain expert for retail, corporate, and SME lending, covering the full loan lifecycle.
  • Prioritize requirements based on customer value, regulatory needs, and commercial impact.
  • Collaborate with engineering, QA, UX, sales, and implementation teams to deliver high-quality releases.
  • Engage with customers and partners to capture real-world lending use cases and support pre-sales discussions.
  • Create PRDs, user stories, and functional documentation in Agile environments (Jira, Confluence).
  • Track product performance post-release and drive continuous improvements.


Skills & Qualifications Required

  • 10+ years of product management experience in BFSI lending or loan management platforms.
  • Strong experience in B2B enterprise software products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology (B.Tech or equivalent).
  • Deep expertise in loan lifecycle management, including EMI/interest calculations, collections, delinquency, restructuring, and closures.
  • Exposure to retail, corporate, SME, or Islamic lending is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, databases, configurable platforms, and Agile tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives with an ownership-driven mindset.

descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Salary range: Rs 2000000 - Rs 3500000 (ie INR 20-35 LPA)

Min Experience: 4+ years

Location: Bengaluru

JobType: full-time

You will operate at the crossroads of academic complexity and user-friendly product design, converting the requirements of administrators, faculty, and students into features that truly revolutionize institutional operations. You will work in close collaboration with teams from engineering, design, customer success, and sales to create a product that connects with institutions throughout India and internationally.

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Take full ownership of and continuously enhance the product roadmap for the Academics vertical, encompassing aspects such as attendance, timetabling, curriculum management, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules
  • Prioritize features and improvements by integrating customer feedback, usage analytics, and current higher education institutional trends
  • Effectively balance immediate customer demands with the long-term vision for the platform, ensuring that all decisions support our growth goals
  • Lead regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty members, and students from partner institutions to identify pain points and unmet requirements
  • Evaluate product usage data, support inquiries, and market insights to uncover gaps and new opportunities for products within the academics vertical
  • Collaborate closely with customer success and sales teams to incorporate the customer's perspective into every sprint and planning session
  • Convert complex academic workflows into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user stories that engineering and design teams can confidently implement
  • Facilitate agile processes including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts across design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to guarantee smooth launches of new features
  • Track adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics following product launches and rapidly iterate based on data and user feedback
  • Maintain a well-organized product backlog, prioritizing tasks that have the greatest impact
  • Serve as the main product liaison for academic module stakeholders, both internally (sales, customer success, engineering) and externally (institutional administrators and faculty)
  • Consistently communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release schedules clearly to leadership and cross-functional team members

Requirements

Must Haves

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in product management within enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a proven history of delivering B2B SaaS products from start to finish
  • Demonstrated capability to independently manage a product vertical—from initial discovery and roadmap development through execution and post-launch refinement
  • Deep understanding of academic workflows in higher education, including timetabling, curriculum management, learning management systems, attendance, and student lifecycle processes
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, comfortable utilizing product analytics tools and translating data into actionable product enhancements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams around a unified product vision
  • Practical experience working in agile environments, conducting sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs

Good to Have

  • Previous experience collaborating with Indian higher education institutions such as universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms like Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary systems, as well as academic ERP solutions
  • Experience using product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or equivalents
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Figma
  • Background in working with customer-facing teams—including sales, support, and customer success—to collect and act upon institutional feedback
  • A passion for the education sector and a sincere interest in enhancing outcomes for students and academic institutions

Must-have Skills

Product Manager, Product Roadmapping, SaaS

Good-to-have Skills

B2B, LMS, ERP

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Noora Health India Private Limited is a key partner in Noora Health’s mission is to improve outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with the skills they need to care for their loved ones. They develop content, technology platforms, new products, and strengthen other operational functions that support the scale and impact of Noora Health’s programs.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

About The Role

The Mobile Care Companion (MCC) is Noora Health's primary digital touchpoint for family caregivers post discharge, serving ~50,000 users a day across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal. It delivers behavior change and health system navigation at scale through two-way conversations, clinical triage, care coordination, and a growing set of AI-powered features.

This role owns MCC end-to-end: the caregiver experience, the health worker tools, the clinical workflows, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what MCC becomes over the next three years, be accountable for both growth and outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, clinical, data, and program functions to get there.

What You Will Do

  • Overall Model: Own the growth and operating model for MCC across user acquisition, activation, and retention at scale, including how MCC is positioned, priced, and deployed across government health systems and private partners
  • AI-led Product Experience: Reimagine the delivery with an AI-first thinking. Reason through where AI owns, where it assists, and where the experts jump in. Embed AI with an eval-led approach iterating to improve accuracy, engagement, and behavior change.
  • Product Roadmap: Set and execute the product roadmap to improve the user experience across the full funnel. Work with country program teams to translate local context (language, literacy, health system constraints) into product decisions that hold across four countries
  • Management & Execution: Deliver individually while also managing and mentoring a team of PMs, designers, clinicians across geographies.
  • Partnership & Advocacy: Represent the product with key internal and external stakeholders including health system partners, funders, leadership, and country teams to drive buy-in and unlock partnerships to drive MCC’s growth.

Who Are We Looking For

  • A 0-to-1 builder/founder: You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment and owned its outcomes. You don't need scaffolding to get started
  • 6–12 years of product experience, with a meaningful share on AI-powered products; Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, MCPs, and optimization workflows
  • Deeply data fluent and strong experimentation instinct: you obsesses about data, you define what good looks like before you build, and you are rigorous about measuring it
  • A first-principles thinker about complex service design. You are quick to build prototypes, sketch flows, write copies, and analyze and cut data to make your vision concrete
  • Able to work across clinical and technical teams, earn credibility with both, and translate between them clearly
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical tools, or other high-stakes domains is a strong plus

What We Value

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial, driven Senior Product Manager to lead the charge on our next-generation AI Insights solutions. In this 0-to-1 role, you will operate with scrappy, startup-minded velocity within the stability and scale of a mid-sized enterprise environment.

You will not just be managing a roadmap; you will be building a product from the ground up that leverages machine learning and AI to deliver actionable, transformative insights to contact center operations. You are comfortable navigating the messiness of real-world data and the limitations of ML models in production, making tough tradeoff calls with incomplete information, and pivoting quickly when things aren't working.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Execution

  • Define and execute the 0-to-1 product strategy for Five9's AI-powered insights and analytics offerings

Navigate Ambiguity

  • Handle real-world data complexities, manage ML model limitations in production environments, and make critical product decisions even when data is incomplete

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Applied Science/ML, Design, and GTM functions to deliver superior products for our customers

Customer-Centric Iteration

  • Actively engage with customers and design partners to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and refine the product roadmap based on real-world usage and pain points

Market Leadership

  • Conduct competitive research and market analysis to identify new opportunities in AI/ML analytics and maintain a competitive edge

Ruthless Prioritization

  • Demonstrate a builder's instinct with strong opinions, loosely held. Know when to double down and possess a track record of confidently killing features or pivoting strategies that aren't working

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • MBA or Master’s in Data Science, Analytics, or related degrees is a plus

Professional Experience

  • 4+ years of comprehensive professional experience in SaaS Product Management
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate adaptability and success across both agile, high-growth startup environments and established enterprise organizations

Product Leadership

  • A proven track record in a formal Product Management capacity, successfully delivering B2B SaaS solutions

Industry Expertise (Required)

  • Essential background in the Contact Center or Customer Experience (CX) industry coupled with direct experience building and shipping AI-driven products

Technical Acumen

  • Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle for ML-driven solutions, including data collection, model training tradeoffs, and analytics

Execution-Oriented

  • A highly autonomous operator capable of driving initiatives forward without relying on extensive operational support structures
  • Must be able to articulate and defend strategic decisions effectively and collaboratively

Critical Competencies

Successful candidates for this role will demonstrate:

Applied AI Proficiency

  • Practical experience managing the realities of LLMs and machine learning deployments, including addressing latency constraints, optimization, and accuracy challenges

Operational Excellence

  • A strong bias for action and a proven ability to translate high-level strategy into tangible, delivered products

Client Advocacy

  • A strong commitment to direct customer interaction and a willingness to engage continuously with clients to resolve challenges, gather feedback, and drive product adoption

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

descriptionHtml:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and carry products that our customers want and enjoy, while ensuring that customers are safe and get safe products from Amazon. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic and driven people. If you'd like to help us build an environment where our customer's safety is paramount, where we enable our customers to find and buy anything online, and where we ensure that we maintain and enhance customer trust on Amazon, then this is your chance to be part of a challenging and strategic initiative.

We're looking for a strong Senior Product Manager - Technical to join our team in Bangalore, India. This role requires exceptional technical depth in Generative AI, as you'll partner with Applied Scientists and Engineering teams to build next-generation AI-powered compliance and safety solutions. You should have strong technical problem-solving skills, product management expertise in AI/ML domains, excellent communication skills, and deep understanding of how to evaluate, deploy, and scale LLM-based systems in production environments. You should also possess the ability to influence people across the organization from tech leadership to business managers by creating win-win solutions, and the desire to be an individual contributor driving Amazon's next generation of AI-powered safety technology.

This role will report into the global product team that enables Trustworthy shopping experience at Amazon and ensures Safety and Compliance across Amazon stores. A primary focus of this role is defining the product strategy and roadmap for GenAI applications that automate compliance workflows, enhance decision-making accuracy, and scale our safety operations globally. You will work closely with Applied Scientists to evaluate LLM capabilities, design human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems, and establish AI governance frameworks that ensure responsible deployment of AI models in high-stakes compliance scenarios.

This role is inherently cross-functional—the professional will work closely with various partner teams across Amazon including Applied Science, Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Safety and Compliance to bring AI-powered products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing tech products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, technically sophisticated in AI/ML domains, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines while managing complex stakeholder alignment.

You should be passionate about retail, supply chain, consumer business, and building meaningful AI-powered products that transform how Amazon ensures customer safety at scale. Prior experience working in product management for AI/ML products, managing GenAI roadmaps, and working in retail or supply chain environments is preferred.

Key job responsibilities

GenAI Product Strategy & Execution

Define and own the 3-5 year product vision and roadmap for GenAI-powered compliance automation, balancing innovation with operational excellence

Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to evaluate LLM capabilities for safety and compliance workflows, including accuracy, latency, cost, and safety guardrails

Design and launch human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems that combine AI automation with human judgment for high-stakes compliance decisions

Establish metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI model performance, including precision/recall, false positive rates, cost per decision, and operational impact

Assess emerging LLM technologies (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) and recommend strategic investments for Amazon's compliance tech stack

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Work with internal customers to understand their use cases, pain points, and requirements for AI-assisted compliance workflows

Collaborate with partner engineering teams to drive product roadmaps for compliance and safety, ensuring technical excellence and scalability

Challenge Science teams on model architecture decisions, technical trade-offs, and design choices to ensure optimal product outcomes

Address bottlenecks, provide customer input, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints

Understand and articulate the technical reasons behind product architecture decisions and recognize when technical design limits future innovation

Cross-Functional Program Management

Partner with multiple tech, product, and operations teams across multiple locations with varying priorities to ensure timely delivery of AI solutions

Clarify and drive project commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability across Science, Engineering, and Operations

Drive adoption of GenAI solutions across global compliance operations through change management, training, and stakeholder engagement

Manage complex initiatives across numerous business models and create certainty out of ambiguity while maintaining firm grasp over operational, financial, and technical aspects

Data-Driven Decision Making

Query and analyze data to derive insightful findings that inform product strategy and prioritization

Define success metrics for AI model deployment including business impact, operational efficiency gains, and customer experience improvements

Conduct cost-benefit analyses for GenAI investments, including model training costs, inference costs, and operational savings

AI Governance & Responsible AI

Establish AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices for compliance use cases

Design evaluation protocols for model safety, bias detection, and fairness in automated decision-making

Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure AI solutions meet regulatory requirements and ethical standards

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today

At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.

In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.

While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!

You need to be a HODLer of these

  • 4-6+ years of relevant product management experience
  • At least 1 year of experience in building and creating product strategy/roadmap.
  • Strong grasp of user centered design process
  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills, and experience interacting with diverse personalities
  • MBA degree from a tier 1/2 business school
  • Bachelo's degree in technology or engineering from a tier 1,/ school

You will be mining through these tasks

  • Role is at an intersection of Payments/Banking rails and Compliance and will need to work closely with senior product managers of these two squads.
  • Manage the focus area for Fund Sources (Banks, On-Ramp Partners), KYC, AML and overall on-ramp/off-ramp rails.
  • Create a roadmap for the enhancements / addition to the product portfolio based on extensive data crunching and clearly defined KPIs and objectives
  • Responsible for delivering critical projects with crucial timelines and significant business impact.
  • Managing and executing decisions about the high-level technical architecture, product processes / automation and UI/UX designs of the project
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across functions to understand the user problem and their needs and formulate achievable requirements for development teams
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth.
  • Person would be willing to write technical PRD’s and work with engineering team and design team and execute the product roadmap
  • The growth path for this role (APM / PM role) can be into a PM/ SPM in either core Payments or Compliance team, based on performance, need of the org and also choice of the candidate.
  • Candidates should have prior product experience in KYC funnels OR Payment Gateway OR Risk/AML. Working with 3P tools like Signzy/Karza OR banking partners is BIG PLUS.

Are you the one? Our missing block

  • You are knowledge-hungry when it comes to VDA and Web3, always eager to dive deeper and stay ahead in this evolving space.
  • The world of Web3 and VDA excites you, fueling your curiosity and driving you to explore new opportunities within this dynamic landscape.
  • You act like an owner, constantly striving for excellence, impact, and tangible results in everything you do.
  • You embrace a ‘We over Me’ mindset, growing individually while fostering the growth of those around you.
  • Change is your catalyst, igniting your passion to build and innovate.
  • You think outside the box, unbound by limitations or doubt, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Perks That Empower You

Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you the freedom to create a work-life balance that truly suits you.﻿﻿

  • Design Your Own Benefit: Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs. Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life, our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritize what matters most to you.
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: We believe in the power of well-being. Take the time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
  • Mental Wellness Support: Your mental health is as important as your professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to help you stay balanced and connected.
  • Bi-Weekly Learning Sessions: These sessions are more than just updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an ever-evolving landscape.

descriptionHtml:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Join Itron as a Product Manager and help shape the future of clean energy. We're looking for a collaborative, systems-minded leader to help evolve our Distributed Intelligence platform, which is a key enabler in building a more sustainable, reliable, and customer-centric electric grid. In this role, you’ll be an active participant in developing software to increase grid resiliency, integrate renewable energy sources, and improve real-time grid operations. The Distributed Intelligence platform serves Itron’s Grid Edge Intelligence applications with a scalable, interoperable, and thoughtfully designed system for managing application deployments and integrating data from multiple sources. As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll define core capabilities for how to deliver software and analytics at the grid edge, and play a key role in unifying platform services across multiple grid management use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape and manage product requirements for Itron’s Distributed Intelligence Enterprise Application Center, which manages utility software applications running at the grid edge.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including engineering, architecture, and implementation—to deliver solutions that are aligned with technical, operational, and customer needs.
  • Contribute to platform software architecture strategy, and design, including performance, normalization, and support for scalable software services.
  • Define how grid edge data is governed, managed, and distributed, to support utility data analytics and artificial intelligence / AI use cases.
  • Support and troubleshoot customer software deployments and migrations, while creating and maintaining technical documentation and solution guidelines.
  • Engage in product discovery to ensure development is grounded in user needs, market insights, and utility goals

Required Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical product management, solution architecture, or energy software development
  • Experience and understanding of distributed software systems such as IoT/internet of things, or utility metering.
  • Adept at evangelizing and driving cross-functional consensus across internal groups and external customers.
  • Understanding of data management and database design principles.
  • Exposure to utility operations systems (e.g., AMI, ADMS, GIS, CIS), or similar from a related field.
  • Strong and flexible communication skills, able to communicate with both a technical and sales audience interchangeably.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, energy systems, or related field

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Previous utility industry experience
  • Understanding of cloud-native platforms and microservices architectures
  • Awareness of cybersecurity best practices for energy systems
  • Experience working in Agile environments and using tools like Microsoft ADS, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps

Master’s degree in technical or energy-related discipline is a plus

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Lead Technical Product Owner (B4)

Position Description

Honeywell's Value Engineering (VE) and Component Engineering (CE) Center of Excellence (COE) is a dynamic collective of professionals dedicated to refining product development through innovative engineering and strategic component selection.

You will be part of Honeywell's VE/CE CoE Advanced Tech team driving Tech Charter & Strategy with focus on how AI/ML can enable us meet VE/CE revenue targets.

You will be driving requirements for AI solutions, outside-in product thinking, conceptualization, and feature scaling for solutions that improve product cost, component strategy, reuse, and business impact. You will own AI product enhancement and roadmap prioritization by partnering with engineering, VECE SMEs, and business stakeholders to convert user requirements into structured features and measurable value realization.

The role drives alignment across VECE, hardware engineering, and AI delivery teams, ensuring solutions are functionally relevant, technically feasible, and scalable across programs and product lines.

The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of experience, prior VECE program exposure, strong business understanding, and a hardware engineering foundation to shape high-impact AI product feature decisions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive end-to-end AI product requirements for VECE use cases by translating business priorities, user feedback, and engineering needs into clear functional requirements and product backlog items.
  • Bring an outside-in perspective to identify AI driven opportunities in value engineering, component optimization, reuse, and feature adoption that improve cost, quality, and business outcomes.
  • Lead AI product conceptualization and feature scaling for VECE-related solutions, ensuring alignment with user workflows, program priorities, and enterprise impact.
  • Prioritize AI enhancements and roadmap decisions based on value realization, implementation feasibility, business case strength, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Partner closely with VECE SMEs, hardware engineering teams, business stakeholders, and AI delivery teams to ensure solutions are relevant, scalable, and operationally effective.
  • Develop business and functional competency plans for delivery teams so they can better understand VECE processes, user pain points, and expected business outcomes.
  • Leverage prior VECE program experience to drive governance, stakeholder alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement across product features and delivery execution.

Skills

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience, including VECE program exposure, strong business acumen, and expertise in product requirements management.
  • Deep product ownership capability, including requirements shaping, feature definition, backlog prioritization, and roadmap decision-making across complex technical environments.
  • Strong VECE functional knowledge, with clear understanding of value engineering, component strategy, cost optimization, reuse opportunities, and business value realization.
  • Ability to translate business problems and user needs into structured functional requirements, scalable product concepts, and adoption-ready features.
  • Strong hardware engineering foundation to understand product architecture, technical feasibility, engineering constraints, and cross-functional trade-offs.
  • Excellent business acumen and outcome orientation, with the ability to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills to align VECE SMEs, engineering teams, business leaders, and AI delivery teams around common product goals.
  • Ability to build functional clarity and delivery readiness by enabling teams with domain context, governance discipline, and clear success measures for product adoption.

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

descriptionHtml:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You'll Be Responsible For

You will define and drive the long-term product strategy for the CPN Payments Engine — the foundational infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across Circle’s global network.

You will operate as the end-to-end owner of payment execution across corridors and rails, shaping how the system evolves to support scale, resilience, and new financial use cases. This includes setting the vision for reliability, performance, and extensibility, and leading cross-functional efforts to translate that vision into measurable improvements in throughput, latency, and network success rates. You will also influence adjacent systems and partner integrations to ensure the Payments Engine operates as a cohesive, high-performing platform across the ecosystem.

Core Requirements

What you'll bring to Circle:

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure
  • Experience owning complex platform or infrastructure products such as payment engines, settlement systems, or distributed processing systems
  • Demonstrated ability to define and drive strategy for ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces with company-level implications
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose systemic issues in payment flows and drive data-informed decisions; proficiency with SQL or equivalent
  • Track record of delivering step-function improvements in system reliability, performance, or scalability
  • Experience influencing architecture and working deeply with Engineering on trade-offs and system design
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and external partners
  • Ability to operate seamlessly from strategic vision to hands-on execution, including writing detailed product and technical specifications
  • Clear and structured communicator, capable of aligning senior stakeholders and driving decision-making

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with global payments networks, settlement systems, or financial infrastructure (e.g., cross-border payments, correspondent banking, stablecoins)
  • Deep understanding of two-sided network dynamics and marketplace liquidity challenges
  • Experience building compliance-forward systems where regulatory requirements shape product and system design
  • Expertise in API product management for enterprise or developer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with payment lifecycle events, failure taxonomy, and large-scale operational tooling for monitoring and exception handling

This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

descriptionHtml:
About Nightfall:

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

About the role:

As a Senior Product Manager at Nightfall you'll lead the development and evolution of our data security product with coverage across SaaS, AI apps, endpoints and all major browser platforms. You'll develop a deep understanding of how organizations secure data and identify critical gaps in their data loss prevention approach especially with the evolving usage of AI apps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ship AI security features fast - building MVPs, gathering feedback, and iterating based on real-world usage
  • Define success metrics: agent deployment rates, detection accuracy, remediation rates, exfiltration prevention metrics, system performance to avoid user friction and more
  • Work directly with engineering on sprint planning, backlog prioritization to achieve predictable release timelines
  • Build competitive differentiation by understanding what competitive vendors do poorly or have lack of coverage with endpoints, AI apps and agentic workflows
  • Document technical capabilities clearly for sales engineering, support, and customers - from architecture diagrams to deployment guides
  • Work with Sales Engineering and Customer Success during proof of value, customer deployments to ensure successful evaluation and adoption
  • Be comfortable presenting the product capabilities and differentiators to CISOs, SecOps teams across customer segments

What you need

Customer-Facing and Collaborative

  • 4 to 6 years of product management experience at a SaaS startup with a highly technical product.
  • Comfortable joining customer calls, demos, and technical discussions - you can speak credibly about how the product works, handle deployment issues, or
  • Experience working closely with sales engineering and customer success - you understand their workflows and help them win deals and secure renewals
  • Strong communication skills and an ability to translate technical requirements from security teams into clear product specifications

Execution-Oriented and Scrappy

  • Bias for action - you ship fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't wait for perfection
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change - you're building a category-defining product in a startup environment
  • Strong prioritization skills - you know what moves the needle vs what can wait
  • Entrepreneurial mindset - you'll do whatever it takes to make customers successful, from troubleshooting agent issues to writing KB articles
  • Hard-working and resilient - this is a high-intensity role that requires deep focus and relentless execution

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience as a founder, security engineer or product manager on an endpoint product or similar hands-on security role
  • Understanding of MDM platforms, strong grasp of endpoint DLP and browser extension architecture, security frameworks and limitations across macOS, Windows
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks, AI apps and agentic workflows and how they drive DLP requirements
  • Experience with ML/AI-based detection and classification systems
  • Background in SaaS security products and understanding of cloud-to-endpoint integration patterns
  • Graduated with a Computer Science (or similar) degree

Environment

Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.

descriptionHtml:
About Josys

Josys is a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup on a mission to simplify and automate IT operations for the modern workplace. Backed by $218M in Series A & B funding and a successful launch in Japan, we’re expanding globally with a footprint in 9 countries and a cutting-edge tech hub in Bengaluru, India.

Spun off from RAKSUL (a Forbes Startup of the Year), Josys offers an all-in-one platform for SaaS and device management, giving IT teams 360° visibility and powerful automation—from employee onboarding to offboarding.

With remote work and SaaS sprawl on the rise, Josys helps businesses cut IT costs by up to 75%, boost security, and stay compliant—all while making IT teams super efficient.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to join Josys and help shape the future of AI-Powered SaaS management.

As a Senior Product Manager at Josys, you’ll play a critical role in building a user-centric B2B SaaS product that streamlines IT SaaS operations, drives automation, and delivers tangible value to enterprises. You’ll own key product areas, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and lead initiatives from discovery to launch. This is a high-impact role where you’ll influence product strategy, prioritize what matters most, and ensure we ship solutions that scale.

Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

As a Senior Product Manager At Josys, You Will

  • Understand market trends & user needs to identify meaningful customer pain points, and translate them into intuitive, scalable product solutions.
  • Break down complex problem statements into actionable, incremental product delivery.
  • Own quarterly planning and roadmap creation for your product domain, setting clear short-term and long-term objectives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success teams to define product requirements and drive end-to-end execution.
  • Conduct customer interviews and analyze feedback to uncover insights that inform product decisions, enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate features and ensure the product meets user expectations before launch.
  • Track adoption and usage of delivered features, gather user feedback and data insights, and drive iterative improvements to maximize product impact.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or related field. MBA is a plus.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, particularly in the B2B SaaS domain.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with a keen eye for detail.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams to drive shared product success
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a continuous learning mindset and a passion for keeping up with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Description

Want to transform the way people interact with Alexa leveraging generative AI? Come join the team that is building the next-generation AI-assistant that gets things done across Timers, Alarms, Reminders, Calendars, Recipes, and News on Alexa devices. In this role, you'll drive product strategy and initiatives for a dedicated area within our Alexa Productivity Essentials team focused on driving engaging, high-traffic productivity scenarios for millions of customers worldwide. You’ll work with CX, science and engineering partners to build our next phase in making Alexa the world’s best personal assistant. The role presents an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience for products that are used every day by people you know. We are looking for someone who is passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, has demonstrated product leadership skills, and thrives in an environment where they collaborate closely with colleagues across product, design, research, science and engineering.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive the architectural and platform vision for the product space
  • Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
  • Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
  • Drive project schedules from design to launch
  • Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
  • Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

About The Team

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. They will have deep technical skills and customer centric mindset with a history of launching notable products.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience building products that leverage A.I., Machine Learning, Speech/Natural Language Understanding

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:
Role: AI - Senior Product Manager

Department: AI Products

Location: Bangalore [In-Office]

Type: Fulltime

YOE: 7+ Years



About us :

Established in 2015, ClickPost is Asia’s fastest-growing Logistics Intelligence Platform, dedicated to enhancing post-purchase experiences for retail brands. With seamless integration with over 500+ carriers, we empower leading retailers across India, including 6 Unicorns, to manage 120+ logistics partners via a single API gateway. Backed by Times Internet, Rebright Partners, and other marquee investors, we have achieved profitability and experienced exponential growth, expanding 10x in the past 2 years.


Role Overview:

  • We are seeking an experienced AI - Senior Product Manager to define product vision, roadmap, and execution strategy for AI-powered products, translating business problems into scalable AI solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building and executing new initiatives and roadmaps, understanding market dynamics, and creating business cases for product opportunities.
  • Additionally, they will scale existing products, drive feature adoption, and enhance the overall product experience through data-driven insights and experimentation.


What you will do :

  • Define product vision, roadmap, and execution strategy for AI-powered products, translating business problems into scalable AI solutions.
  • Work closely with engineering, data science, design, and GTM teams to deliver high-impact AI features from concept to launch.
  • Own product discovery by identifying customer pain points, validating opportunities, and prioritizing initiatives using data and user feedback.
  • Drive AI model adoption, performance, and business outcomes through experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimization.
  • Stay current with advancements in AI/LLMs and convert emerging technologies into practical product capabilities that create measurable customer value.
  • Manage product launches end to end with beta customers and internal teams
  • Conduct customer interviews and gather insights to inform feature releases and customization requests.
  • Advocate for cross-sell and upsell opportunities to drive business growth.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and customer facing teams to deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Establish strong team culture and lead squad sprints, setting responsibilities, and reviewing deliverables.


What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • 5+ years of hands-on product management experience across Product, AI/ML, or Technical Product roles, with a proven track record of building and scaling production-grade enterprise AI products.
  • Understanding in modern AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, embeddings, prompt engineering, AI orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
  • A relentless growth mindset with a strong bias for action
  • Demonstrated success in leading Enterprise/B2B product launches from concept to market.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, prioritization, and long-term roadmap creation skills.
  • Industry experience and familiarity with AI, UI design, APIs, and web/mobile application architectures.
  • In-depth understanding of the E-commerce ecosystem, funnels, agile methodologies, and product documentation.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, adept at transforming broad ideas into actionable plans.
  • Empathetic towards users and colleagues, creative, and enthusiastic about innovation.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in relevant field; preference for Computer Science background.
  • If you meet the qualifications and are passionate about driving product innovation in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to lead our product team.


Perks & Benefits:

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Competitive salary package with performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Flexible working hours with Hybrid work arrangement.
  • Generous vacation and time off.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Employee assistance program for mental health and well-being support.
  • Supportive and inclusive work culture promoting diversity and collaboration.

descriptionHtml:
Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend. A pioneer in Hybrid ITAM and FinOps, Flexera provides award-winning, data-oriented SaaS solutions for technology value optimization (TVO), enabling IT, finance, procurement and cloud teams to gain deep insights into cost optimization, compliance and risks for each business service. Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology Blueprint™ in hybrid environments—from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud.

We’re transforming the software industry.  We’re Flexera.  With more than 50,000 customers across the world, we’re achieving that goal. But we know we can’t do any of that without our team. Ready to help us re-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans?  Come and see why we’re consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC as a category leader in the marketplace. Learn more at flexera.com

We are hiring a Product Owner to drive the TI Platform execution work, with a focus on data and third-party integration to enhance overall platform capabilities. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you will manage the product backlog, prioritize features, and collaborate with engineering, and stakeholders to deliver seamless integrations that support Flexera’s strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • TI Platform Data Model and Key Service Development:
  • Define and prioritize the product backlog for TI Platform, focusing on data and third-party integration to streamline our overall roadmap.
  • Collaborate with engineering to design and implement API and AI-first solutions, ensuring compatibility with Flexera One.
  • Drive integration with internal products (e.g., IT Visibility dashboards, CCO, ITAM, etc systems) to enhance data flows and analytics.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration:
  • Act as the primary liaison between Product Management, engineering, and internal teams, ensuring alignment on priorities and deliverables.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, retrospectives) to maintain momentum post our recent Itasca workshop.
  • Translate business needs into technical requirements, creating user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Adoption and Continuous Improvement:
  • Drive adoption of platform services across internal teams, targeting 90% adoption within six months.
  • Gather feedback from stakeholders to iterate on connector features, ensuring they deliver measurable value (e.g., improved cost tracking).

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years as a Product Owner in a technical integration role.
  • Proven expertise in API and AI-first integrations
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, managing backlogs, and working with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with Data Model, Lakehouse, and Data product knowledge
  • Strong communication skills to bridge technical and business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field;

Why Join Flexera?

  • Shape the future of IT management by driving impactful integrations for TI Platform.
  • Enjoy competitive salary, benefits, and flexible work options.

Flexera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  Qualified applicants will be considered for open roles regardless of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local/national laws, policies and/or regulations. 

Flexera understands the value that results from employing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce. We recognize that equity necessitates acknowledging past exclusion and that inclusion requires intentional effort. Our DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) council is the driving force behind our commitment to championing policies and practices that foster a welcoming environment for all.

We encourage candidates requiring accommodations to please let us know by emailing careers@flexera.com.
